source.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁמַ֤ע אֶל־הַֽחֻקִּים֙ וְאֶל־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָֽנֹכִ֛י מְלַמֵּ֥ד אֶתְכֶ֖ם לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת לְמַ֣עַן תִּֽחְי֗וּ וּבָאתֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the judgments that I [am] teaching you to do, so that you may live and go in and take possession of the land that Yahweh, [the] God of your fathers, [is] giving to you.

en.L: And now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the judgments that I [am] teaching you to do, so that you may live, and go in and take possession of the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, [the] God of your fathers, [is] giving you.
en.B: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and rulings that I am teaching you to put into practice. Then you will live, and you will enter and take possession of the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of your ancestors, is giving you.
en.R: Now, Israel, listen to the laws and rules I am teaching you, and obey them. Then you will live, and you will go in and take possession of the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of your ancestors, is giving you.

es.L: Y ahora, Israel, escucha los estatutos y los juicios que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} enseño a hacer, para que {{plural_you:vivan|viváis}} y {{plural_you:entren|entréis}} y {{plural_you:tomen|toméis}} posesión de la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, [el] Dios de {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} da.
es.B: Ahora, Israel, escucha los estatutos y las normas que {{plural_you:les|os}} enseño para que los {{plural_you:pongan|pongáis}} en práctica. Así {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}}, y {{plural_you:entrarán|entraréis}} y {{plural_you:tomarán|tomaréis}} posesión de la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} da.
es.R: Ahora, Israel, escucha las leyes y las normas que {{plural_you:les|os}} estoy enseñando, para que {{plural_you:las obedezcan|las obedezcáis}}. Así {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}}, y {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} entrar y tomar posesión de la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} está dando.

fr.L: Et maintenant, Israël, écoute les prescriptions et les jugements que je vous enseigne à pratiquer, afin que vous viviez, et que vous entriez et preniez possession du pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [le] Dieu de vos pères, vous donne.
fr.B: Maintenant, Israël, écoute les prescriptions et les règles que je vous enseigne pour que vous les mettiez en pratique. Alors vous vivrez, et vous entrerez et prendrez possession du pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de vos ancêtres, vous donne.
fr.R: Maintenant, Israël, écoute les lois et les règles que je vous enseigne, pour que vous leur obéissiez. Alors vous vivrez, et vous pourrez entrer dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de vos ancêtres, vous donne, et en prendre possession.

sw.L: Na sasa, Israeli, sikiliza kanuni na hukumu ambazo mimi ninawafundisha kuzitenda, ili mpate kuishi, na kuingia na kuimiliki nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa baba zenu, anawapa.
sw.B: Sasa, Israeli, sikiliza kanuni na maagizo ninayowafundisha, ili mpate kuyatenda. Ndipo mtaishi, na mtaingia na kuimiliki nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa mababu zenu, anawapa.
sw.R: Sasa, Israeli, sikiliza sheria na maagizo ninayowafundisha, kisha myatii. Ndipo mtaishi, na mtaingia katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa mababu zenu, anawapa, na kuimiliki.

decisions.choice: And now: the turn from what has happened to what Israel must do
decisions.reason: Chapters 1-3 retell the journey from Horeb to the plains of Moab. "And now" draws the lesson from that history: the God who has led them this far calls them to listen and obey. The rest of chapter 4 is the close of Moses' first speech.

decisions.choice: statutes and judgments: the whole body of God's law
decisions.reason: The two words are often paired in Deuteronomy (4:5, 8, 14; 5:1; 12:1). The first is a fixed rule or decree; the second a ruling, a decision about what is right in a case. Together they name everything Moses is about to teach.

decisions.choice: so that you may live: life in the land comes with obedience
decisions.reason: To live is more than to survive. It is the full life God gives his people in the land, and Deuteronomy ties it again and again to listening to him (4:4, 40; 30:15-20). The verse sets life before them as the goal of the law.

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "fathers" means the forebears of the people, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob and those after them. Balanced and Readable say "ancestors"; Literal keeps "fathers".

decisions.choice: Then you will live
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable split the long sentence and make the result of obeying a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: "los estatutos y los juicios" (L); "los estatutos y las normas" (B); "las leyes y las normas" (R)
decisions.reason: For Deuteronomy's recurring pair (4:1, 5, 8, 14; 5:1; 12:1). Literal keeps "juicios" for mishpatim, as the English keeps "judgments"; Balanced and Readable say "normas", the word the Pentateuch terms list uses for a rule, so that "mandamientos" stays for the commandments.

decisions.choice: "les prescriptions et les jugements" (L); "les prescriptions et les règles" (B); "les lois et les règles" (R)
decisions.reason: For Deuteronomy's recurring pair (4:1, 5, 8, 14; 5:1; 12:1), as the Pentateuch terms list and Exodus 21:1 have them: Literal keeps "jugements" for mishpatim, as the English keeps "judgments"; Balanced says "règles"; Readable follows the English "laws and rules".

decisions.choice: "kanuni na hukumu" (L); "kanuni na maagizo" (B); "sheria na maagizo" (R)
decisions.reason: For Deuteronomy's recurring pair (4:1, 5, 8, 14; 5:1; 12:1), as the Pentateuch terms list and Exodus 21:1 have them: Literal keeps "hukumu" (judgments) for mishpatim; Balanced says "maagizo"; Readable follows the English "laws and rules". "Amri" stays for the commandments (mitsvot).

source.text: לֹ֣א תֹסִ֗פוּ עַל־הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תִגְרְע֖וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ לִשְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת־מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Not you shall add to the word that I [am] commanding you, and not you shall take away from it, to keep [the] commandments of Yahweh your God that I [am] commanding you.

en.L: You shall not add to the word that I [am] commanding you, and you shall not take away from it, so as to keep the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God that I [am] commanding you.
en.B: Add nothing to the word I am commanding you, and take nothing away from it, so that you keep the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God that I am giving you.
en.R: Do not add anything to what I command you, and do not take anything away from it. Just obey the commands of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God that I am giving you.

es.L: No {{plural_you:añadirán|añadiréis}} a la palabra que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} mando, y no {{plural_you:quitarán|quitaréis}} de ella, para guardar los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} mando.
es.B: No {{plural_you:añadan|añadáis}} nada a la palabra que {{plural_you:les|os}} mando, ni {{plural_you:quiten|quitéis}} nada de ella; así {{plural_you:guardarán|guardaréis}} los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} doy.
es.R: No {{plural_you:agreguen|agreguéis}} nada a lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} mando, ni {{plural_you:quiten|quitéis}} nada. Solo {{plural_you:obedezcan|obedeced}} los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} que {{plural_you:les|os}} estoy dando.

fr.L: Vous n’ajouterez pas à la parole que je vous commande, et vous n’en retrancherez pas, pour garder les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu que je vous commande.
fr.B: N’ajoutez rien à la parole que je vous prescris et n’en retirez rien : ainsi vous garderez les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu que je vous transmets.
fr.R: N’ajoutez rien à ce que je vous commande, et n’en enlevez rien. Obéissez simplement aux commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu, que je vous donne.

sw.L: Msiongeze katika neno ninalowaamuru, wala msipunguze kutoka kwalo, ili mzishike amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu ninazowaamuru.
sw.B: Msiongeze chochote katika neno ninalowaamuru, wala msipunguze chochote, ili mpate kushika amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu ninazowapa.
sw.R: Msiongeze kitu katika yale ninayowaamuru, wala msiondoe kitu. Shikeni tu amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu ninazowapa.

decisions.choice: the word: all that Moses commands, taken as one whole
decisions.reason: "Word" is singular. It sums up the whole of what Moses is commanding as a single message from God, not one saying among many.

decisions.choice: neither add nor take away: the command stands as God gave it
decisions.reason: No one may improve God's law by adding rules of their own, or soften it by leaving parts out. Deuteronomy repeats the warning at 13:1 (Hebrew numbering), and Proverbs 30:6 and Revelation 22:18-19 echo it.

decisions.choice: to keep: the way to keep the commandments is to leave them unchanged
decisions.reason: The infinitive "to keep" shows the purpose of the two warnings: by neither adding nor removing, Israel keeps God's commandments as they are.

decisions.choice: I am giving you
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "I am commanding you" twice. Balanced and Readable say "giving" the second time to avoid the repetition; Literal keeps both.

source.text: עֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ הָֽרֹאֹ֔ת אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה בְּבַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר כִּ֣י כָל־הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָלַךְ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י בַֽעַל־פְּע֔וֹר הִשְׁמִיד֛וֹ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Your eyes [are] the [ones] seeing what did Yahweh at Baal-peor; for every man who walked after Baal-peor, destroyed him Yahweh your God from your midst.

en.L: Your eyes [are] the ones that saw what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} did at Baal-peor; for every man who walked after Baal-peor, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God destroyed him from your midst.
en.B: Your own eyes have seen what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} did at Baal-peor: every man who went after the Baal of Peor, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God wiped out from among you.
en.R: You saw for yourselves what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} did at Baal-peor. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God wiped out every man among you who worshiped the god Baal there.

es.L: {{plural_you:Los ojos de ustedes|Vuestros ojos}} [son] los que vieron lo que hizo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en Baal-peor; porque a todo hombre que anduvo tras Baal-peor, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios lo destruyó de en medio de ti.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes han|Vosotros habéis}} visto con {{plural_you:sus propios ojos|vuestros propios ojos}} lo que hizo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en Baal-peor: a todo hombre que siguió al Baal de Peor, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios lo exterminó de en medio de ti.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes vieron|Vosotros visteis}} con {{plural_you:sus propios ojos|vuestros propios ojos}} lo que hizo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en Baal-peor. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios eliminó de en medio de ti a todos los hombres que adoraron allí al dios Baal.

fr.L: Vos yeux [sont] ceux qui ont vu ce qu’a fait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à Baal-Peor ; car tout homme qui a marché derrière Baal-Peor, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu l’a détruit du milieu de toi.
fr.B: Vous avez vu de vos propres yeux ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait à Baal-Peor : tous les hommes qui avaient suivi le Baal de Peor, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu les a exterminés du milieu de toi.
fr.R: Vous avez vu vous-mêmes ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait à Baal-Peor. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu a fait disparaître du milieu de toi tous les hommes qui y avaient adoré le dieu Baal.

sw.L: Macho yenu [ndiyo] yaliyoona aliyoyafanya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Baal-peori; kwa maana kila mwanamume aliyemfuata Baal-peori, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alimwangamiza kutoka katikati yako.
sw.B: Macho yenu wenyewe yameona alichofanya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Baal-peori: kila mwanamume aliyemfuata Baali wa Peori, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alimfutilia mbali kutoka miongoni mwako.
sw.R: Ninyi wenyewe mliona kwa macho yenu alichofanya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Baal-peori. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako aliwaangamiza kutoka miongoni mwako wanaume wote walioabudu mungu Baali huko.

decisions.choice: Baal-peor: Israel's worship of the god of Peor in Moab
decisions.reason: Numbers 25:1-9 tells how men of Israel joined the Moabites in worshiping Baal of Peor, and how those who did died in a plague. The people Moses now speaks to saw it happen only a short time before.

decisions.choice: walked after: followed as a god, gave loyalty and worship
decisions.reason: To walk after a god is to follow and serve it (6:14; 8:19). The picture is of a servant walking behind a master.

decisions.choice: Baal-peor: the name both of the place and of the god worshiped there
decisions.reason: "At Baal-peor" names the place; "after Baal-peor" names the god, "Baal" (lord, master) of Peor. The same name serves for both.

decisions.choice: every man: the men who joined in that worship
decisions.reason: The word can mean "each person", but Numbers 25 tells of men who joined themselves to Baal of Peor through Moabite women, and "every man" fits that account.

decisions.choice: who worshiped the god Baal there
decisions.reason: Readable explains "walked after Baal-peor" and says that Baal was a god.

decisions.choice: plural "{{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}" for "your eyes", then singular "tu Dios", "de en medio de ti"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew shifts from plural to singular inside the verse, and Spanish follows its number at every level, as set at 1:8.

source.text: וְאַתֶּם֙ הַדְּבֵקִ֔ים בַּיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם חַיִּ֥ים כֻּלְּכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: But you, the [ones] holding fast to Yahweh your God, [are] alive all of you this day.

en.L: But you who held fast to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God [are] alive, all of you, this day.
en.B: But you who clung to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God are alive today, every one of you.
en.R: But all of you who stayed loyal to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God are still alive today.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que {{plural_you:se aferraron|os aferrasteis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, [{{plural_you:están|estáis}}] vivos, todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, este día.
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, que {{plural_you:se mantuvieron|os mantuvisteis}} unidos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, {{plural_you:están|estáis}} hoy vivos, todos y cada uno.
es.R: Pero todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que {{plural_you:permanecieron|permanecisteis}} fieles {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} vivos hoy.

fr.L: Mais vous qui vous êtes attachés {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu, [vous êtes] vivants, vous tous, ce jour.
fr.B: Mais vous qui êtes restés attachés {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu, vous êtes tous vivants aujourd’hui.
fr.R: Mais vous tous qui êtes restés fidèles {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu, vous êtes encore en vie aujourd’hui.

sw.L: Lakini ninyi mlioshikamana na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, [mko] hai, ninyi nyote, siku hii.
sw.B: Lakini ninyi mlioambatana na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu mko hai leo, kila mmoja wenu.
sw.R: Lakini ninyi nyote mliobaki waaminifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu bado mko hai leo.

decisions.choice: holding fast: clinging, staying joined in loyalty
decisions.reason: The word means to stick or cling to something. It is used of a man joined to his wife (Genesis 2:24) and of Israel's loyalty to God (10:20; 13:5 in Hebrew numbering; 30:20).

decisions.choice: alive: the living, set against those who died at Peor
decisions.reason: Those who followed Baal died; those who held to the LORD live. The contrast shows what verse 1 means by "so that you may live".

decisions.choice: stayed loyal
decisions.reason: Readable uses plain words for the picture of clinging to God.

source.text: רְאֵ֣ה׀לִמַּ֣דְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֗ם חֻקִּים֙ וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוַּ֖נִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת כֵּ֔ן בְּקֶ֣רֶב הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם בָּאִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: See, I have taught you statutes and judgments, just as commanded me Yahweh my God, to do so in [the] midst of the land where you [are] going there to take possession of it.

en.L: See, I have taught you statutes and judgments just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God commanded me, to do so in the midst of the land that you [are] going into to take possession of it.
en.B: See, I have taught you statutes and rulings, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God commanded me, for you to live by in the land you are going into to take possession of.
en.R: Listen: I have taught you laws and rules, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God told me to. You are to obey them in the land you are about to enter and take possession of.

es.L: Mira, {{plural_you:les|os}} he enseñado estatutos y juicios, tal como me mandó {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mi Dios, para que [los] {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} así en medio de la tierra adonde {{plural_you:ustedes van|vosotros vais}} para tomar posesión de ella.
es.B: Mira, {{plural_you:les|os}} he enseñado estatutos y normas, como me mandó {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mi Dios, para que {{plural_you:vivan|viváis}} conforme a ellos en la tierra donde {{plural_you:van|vais}} a entrar para tomar posesión de ella.
es.R: Escucha: {{plural_you:les|os}} he enseñado leyes y normas, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mi Dios me mandó. {{plural_you:Deberán|Deberéis}} obedecerlas en la tierra donde {{plural_you:están|estáis}} a punto de entrar para tomar posesión de ella.

fr.L: Vois, je vous ai enseigné des prescriptions et des jugements, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu me l’a commandé, pour [les] pratiquer ainsi au milieu du pays où vous entrez pour en prendre possession.
fr.B: Regarde : je vous ai enseigné des prescriptions et des règles, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu me l’a ordonné, pour que vous les suiviez dans le pays où vous allez entrer pour en prendre possession.
fr.R: Écoute : je vous ai enseigné des lois et des règles, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu me l’a demandé. Vous devrez leur obéir dans le pays où vous allez bientôt entrer pour en prendre possession.

sw.L: Tazama, nimewafundisha kanuni na hukumu, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu alivyoniamuru, ili mzitende hivyo katikati ya nchi mnayoiendea ili kuimiliki.
sw.B: Tazama, nimewafundisha kanuni na maagizo, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu alivyoniamuru, ili myafuate katika nchi mnayoingia kuimiliki.
sw.R: Sikiliza: nimewafundisha sheria na maagizo, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu aliniambia. Mtapaswa kuyatii katika nchi mtakayoingia hivi karibuni ili kuimiliki.

decisions.choice: See: a call for attention
decisions.reason: "See" here does not ask anyone to look at something. It calls the hearers to take note of what follows.

decisions.choice: as the LORD my God commanded me: Moses teaches only what God gave him
decisions.reason: Moses claims no law of his own. What he teaches comes from God, who commanded him to teach it (verse 14; 1:3).

decisions.choice: in the midst of the land: the law is meant for life in the land
decisions.reason: The statutes are given now, before the crossing, to be done once Israel lives in the land. Much of the law assumes a settled people with towns, fields and courts.

decisions.choice: Listen
decisions.reason: Readable says "Listen" so that young readers do not take "See" as an order to look.

source.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֮ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם֒ כִּ֣י הִ֤וא חָכְמַתְכֶם֙ וּבִ֣ינַתְכֶ֔ם לְעֵינֵ֖י הָעַמִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁמְע֗וּן אֵ֚ת כָּל־הַחֻקִּ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְאָמְר֗וּ רַ֚ק עַם־חָכָ֣ם וְנָב֔וֹן הַגּ֥וֹי הַגָּד֖וֹל הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And you shall keep and do [them], for it [is] your wisdom and your understanding in [the] eyes of the peoples who will hear all the statutes these, and they will say, surely a people wise and understanding [is] the nation great this.

en.L: And you shall keep and do [them], for that [is] your wisdom and your understanding in the eyes of the peoples, who will hear all these statutes and say, 'Surely this great nation [is] a wise and understanding people.'
en.B: Keep them and follow them, for that is what will make you wise and understanding in the eyes of the peoples. When they hear about all these statutes, they will say, 'This great nation is truly a wise and understanding people.'
en.R: Obey these laws carefully. That is how the other nations will see how wise and understanding you are. They will hear about all these laws and say, 'What a wise and understanding people this great nation is!'

es.L: Y {{plural_you:guardarán|guardaréis}} y {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} [eso], porque esa [es] {{plural_you:la sabiduría y la inteligencia de ustedes|vuestra sabiduría y vuestra inteligencia}} a los ojos de los pueblos, que oirán todos estos estatutos y dirán: “Ciertamente esta gran nación [es] un pueblo sabio e inteligente.”
es.B: {{plural_you:Guárdenlos y pónganlos|Guardadlos y ponedlos}} en práctica, porque eso es lo que {{plural_you:los hará|os hará}} sabios e inteligentes a los ojos de los pueblos. Cuando oigan hablar de todos estos estatutos, dirán: “De veras esta gran nación es un pueblo sabio e inteligente.”
es.R: {{plural_you:Obedezcan|Obedeced}} estas leyes con cuidado. Así las otras naciones verán lo sabios e inteligentes que {{plural_you:son|sois}}. Oirán hablar de todas estas leyes y dirán: “¡Qué pueblo tan sabio e inteligente es esta gran nación!”

fr.L: Et vous [les] garderez et [les] pratiquerez, car c’est là votre sagesse et votre intelligence aux yeux des peuples, qui entendront toutes ces prescriptions et diront : “Assurément, cette grande nation [est] un peuple sage et intelligent.”
fr.B: Gardez-les et mettez-les en pratique, car c’est ce qui fera votre sagesse et votre intelligence aux yeux des peuples. Quand ils entendront parler de toutes ces prescriptions, ils diront : “Cette grande nation est vraiment un peuple sage et intelligent.”
fr.R: Obéissez soigneusement à ces lois. C’est ainsi que les autres nations verront combien vous êtes sages et intelligents. Elles entendront parler de toutes ces lois et diront : “Quel peuple sage et intelligent que cette grande nation !”

sw.L: Nanyi mtazishika na kuzitenda, kwa maana hiyo [ndiyo] hekima yenu na ufahamu wenu machoni pa mataifa, watakaosikia kanuni hizi zote na kusema, 'Hakika taifa hili kubwa [ni] watu wenye hekima na ufahamu.'
sw.B: Zishikeni na kuzitekeleza, kwa maana hilo ndilo litakalowafanya mwonekane wenye hekima na ufahamu machoni pa mataifa. Watakaposikia habari za kanuni hizi zote, watasema, 'Kweli taifa hili kubwa ni watu wenye hekima na ufahamu.'
sw.R: Zitiini sheria hizi kwa uangalifu. Hivyo ndivyo mataifa mengine yatakavyoona jinsi mlivyo na hekima na ufahamu. Yatasikia habari za sheria hizi zote na kusema, 'Kumbe taifa hili kubwa ni watu wenye hekima na ufahamu mwingi!'

decisions.choice: it: the keeping and doing of the statutes
decisions.reason: "It" points back to what Israel does: keeping and doing the law is what makes them wise in others' sight, not merely having it.

decisions.choice: wisdom and understanding: skill in living and insight into what is right
decisions.reason: In the Old Testament wisdom is practical: knowing how to live well before God and others (Proverbs 1:2-7). Understanding is the ability to see into things and judge rightly.

decisions.choice: surely: an exclamation of surprise and admiration
decisions.reason: The small word often means "only", but at the head of a saying like this it stresses what follows: "truly", "indeed".

decisions.choice: What a wise and understanding people this great nation is!
decisions.reason: Readable turns the nations' words into an exclamation, which carries the force of "surely" in plain English.

decisions.choice: "kushika na kutenda" (L); "kushika na kutekeleza" (B); "kutii kwa uangalifu" (R)
decisions.reason: For Deuteronomy's recurring "keep and do" (shamar and asah, 4:6; 5:1, 32; 6:3): "kushika" is to keep or observe a command, and "kutenda" / "kutekeleza" to carry it out. Readable follows the English "obey carefully".

source.text: כִּ֚י מִי־ג֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר־ל֥וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים קְרֹבִ֣ים אֵלָ֑יו כַּיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ בְּכָּל־קָרְאֵ֖נוּאֵלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: For who [is] a nation great that has to it gods near to it like Yahweh our God in all our calling to him?

en.L: For what great nation [is there] that has gods [so] near to it as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God [is] whenever we call to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?
en.B: For what great nation has gods as near to it as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God is to us whenever we call to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?
en.R: No other nation, however great, has gods as near to it as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God is to us. He is near whenever we call out to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Porque ¿qué nación grande [hay] que tenga dioses [tan] cercanos a ella como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios [lo está] cada vez que clamamos a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}?
es.B: Pues ¿qué nación grande tiene dioses tan cerca de ella como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios está de nosotros siempre que clamamos a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}?
es.R: Ninguna otra nación, por grande que sea, tiene dioses tan cerca de ella como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios está de nosotros. Él está cerca cada vez que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llamamos.

fr.L: Car quelle [est la] grande nation qui ait des dieux [aussi] proches d’elle que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu [l’est] chaque fois que nous crions vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ?
fr.B: Quelle grande nation, en effet, a des dieux aussi proches d’elle que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu l’est de nous chaque fois que nous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}invoquons ?
fr.R: Aucune autre nation, si grande soit-elle, n’a des dieux aussi proches d’elle que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu l’est de nous. Il est près de nous chaque fois que nous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appelons.

sw.L: Kwa maana ni taifa gani kubwa lililo na miungu iliyo karibu nalo kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu [alivyo] kila tunapomwita?
sw.B: Kwa maana ni taifa gani kubwa lenye miungu iliyo karibu nalo kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu alivyo karibu nasi kila tunapomlilia?
sw.R: Hakuna taifa jingine, hata likiwa kubwa namna gani, lenye miungu iliyo karibu nalo kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu alivyo karibu nasi. Yuko karibu kila tunapomwita.

decisions.choice: gods near: the nations' gods, compared with Israel's God
decisions.reason: The word for God or gods is plural in form, and here its adjective "near" is plural too. That suggests "gods", the gods of other nations. But a plural adjective is used with Israel's God as well (Joshua 24:19), so the line may mean "a god so near". Either way the point is the same: no nation has a god who comes near as the LORD does.

decisions.choice: who? : a question that expects the answer "none"
decisions.reason: Moses asks the question to make a point. No great nation has such a god.

decisions.choice: call to him: pray, cry out for help
decisions.reason: To call to God is to pray to him, especially in need (Psalm 145:18). The LORD's nearness is shown in his hearing and answering.

decisions.choice: No other nation, however great, has ...
decisions.reason: Readable states the answer the question expects instead of asking it, and repeats "near" in a second sentence to keep the sentences short.

source.text: וּמִי֙ גּ֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר־ל֛וֹ חֻקִּ֥ים וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֖ים צַדִּיקִ֑ם כְּכֹל֙ הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: And who [is] a nation great that has to it statutes and judgments righteous like all the law this which I [am] setting before you today?

en.L: And what great nation [is there] that has statutes and judgments [as] righteous as all this law that I [am] setting before you today?
en.B: And what great nation has statutes and rulings as righteous as this whole law that I put before you today?
en.R: And no other nation, however great, has laws and rules as right and fair as all this teaching I am giving you today.

es.L: ¿Y qué nación grande [hay] que tenga estatutos y juicios [tan] justos como toda esta ley que yo pongo delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} hoy?
es.B: ¿Y qué nación grande tiene estatutos y normas tan justos como toda esta ley que hoy pongo delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?
es.R: Y ninguna otra nación, por grande que sea, tiene leyes y normas tan rectas y justas como toda esta enseñanza que hoy {{plural_you:les|os}} doy.

fr.L: Et quelle [est la] grande nation qui ait des prescriptions et des jugements [aussi] justes que toute cette loi que je mets devant vous aujourd’hui ?
fr.B: Et quelle grande nation a des prescriptions et des règles aussi justes que toute cette loi que je vous présente aujourd’hui ?
fr.R: Et aucune autre nation, si grande soit-elle, n’a des lois et des règles aussi droites et justes que tout cet enseignement que je vous donne aujourd’hui.

sw.L: Na ni taifa gani kubwa lililo na kanuni na hukumu za haki kama sheria hii yote ninayoiweka mbele yenu leo?
sw.B: Na ni taifa gani kubwa lenye kanuni na maagizo ya haki kama sheria hii yote ninayoiweka mbele yenu leo?
sw.R: Tena hakuna taifa jingine, hata likiwa kubwa namna gani, lenye sheria na maagizo yaliyo sawa na ya haki kama mafundisho haya yote ninayowapa leo.

decisions.choice: righteous: right, fair, in line with what is just
decisions.reason: The word describes what matches the right standard: laws that are fair and good, which treat people justly. God himself is the standard (32:4).

decisions.choice: law: the whole of Moses' teaching
decisions.reason: As at 1:5, the word means instruction, everything Moses teaches about how Israel is to live with God, not only rules.

decisions.choice: right and fair ... teaching
decisions.reason: Readable says "right and fair" for the one Hebrew word and "teaching" for the law, as Deuteronomy's terms call for. It states the answer to the question, as in verse 7.

source.text: רַ֡ק הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֩ וּשְׁמֹ֨ר נַפְשְׁךָ֜ מְאֹ֗ד פֶּן־תִּשְׁכַּ֨ח אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־רָא֣וּ עֵינֶ֗יךָ וּפֶן־יָס֨וּרוּ֙ מִלְּבָ֣בְךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּ֑יךָ וְהוֹדַעְתָּ֥ם לְבָנֶ֖יךָ וְלִבְנֵ֥י בָנֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Only take care for yourself and guard your soul exceedingly, lest you forget the things that have seen your eyes, and lest they depart from your heart all [the] days of your life; and you shall make them known to your children and to [the] children of your children,

en.L: Only take care for yourself, and guard your soul greatly, lest you forget the things that your eyes have seen, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; and you shall make them known to your {{gender:children|sons}} and to your {{gender:children's children|sons' sons}},
en.B: Only guard yourself and keep close watch over your life, so that you do not forget what your own eyes have seen, and so that it does not leave your mind for as long as you live. Make it known to your {{gender:children|sons}} and your {{gender:grandchildren|grandsons}},
en.R: But be careful, and keep watch over yourselves. Never forget the things you saw with your own eyes. Keep them in your minds as long as you live. Teach them to your {{gender:children|sons}} and {{gender:grandchildren|grandsons}}.

es.L: Solo cuídate a ti mismo y vigila mucho tu alma, no sea que olvides las cosas que vieron tus ojos, y no sea que se aparten de tu corazón todos los días de tu vida; y las darás a conocer a tus hijos y a los hijos de tus hijos,
es.B: Solo ten cuidado y vigila bien tu vida, para que no olvides lo que han visto tus propios ojos ni se te borre de la mente mientras vivas. Dalo a conocer a tus hijos y a tus nietos,
es.R: Pero ten cuidado y vigílate bien. Nunca olvides lo que viste con tus propios ojos. Recuérdalo mientras vivas. Enséñaselo a tus hijos y a tus nietos.

fr.L: Seulement, prends garde à toi et garde bien ton âme, de peur que tu n’oublies les choses que tes yeux ont vues, et de peur qu’elles ne s’écartent de ton cœur tous les jours de ta vie ; et tu les feras connaître à tes {{gender:enfants|fils}} et aux {{gender:enfants de tes enfants|fils de tes fils}},
fr.B: Seulement, garde-toi et veille bien sur ta vie, pour ne pas oublier ce que tes propres yeux ont vu, et pour que cela ne sorte pas de ta mémoire aussi longtemps que tu vivras. Fais-le connaître à tes {{gender:enfants|fils}} et à tes {{gender:petits-enfants|petits-fils}},
fr.R: Mais fais attention et veille bien sur toi. N’oublie jamais ce que tu as vu de tes propres yeux. Garde-le en mémoire toute ta vie. Enseigne-le à tes {{gender:enfants|fils}} et à tes {{gender:petits-enfants|petits-fils}}.

sw.L: Ila ujihadhari, uilinde nafsi yako sana, usije ukasahau mambo ambayo macho yako yameona, na yasije yakaondoka moyoni mwako siku zote za maisha yako; nawe utawajulisha watoto wako na watoto wa watoto wako,
sw.B: Ila jilinde, ukaulinde sana uhai wako, usije ukasahau yale ambayo macho yako mwenyewe yameona, wala yasitoke akilini mwako maadamu u hai. Wajulishe watoto wako na wajukuu wako,
sw.R: Lakini kuwa mwangalifu, ujilinde vizuri. Usisahau kamwe mambo uliyoyaona kwa macho yako mwenyewe. Uyakumbuke siku zote za maisha yako. Wafundishe watoto wako na wajukuu wako.

decisions.choice: your soul: yourself, your life
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word often called "soul" means the living person, the self. To guard one's soul is to watch over oneself.

decisions.choice: you (singular): the people addressed as one
decisions.reason: Moses moves between "you" plural and "you" singular. The singular speaks to Israel as one people, and to each person in it.

decisions.choice: heart: the mind and memory
decisions.reason: In Hebrew the heart is where a person thinks, remembers and decides. Things that depart from the heart are forgotten.

decisions.choice: make them known to your children: memory passed from one generation to the next
decisions.reason: What Israel saw is to be told to children and grandchildren who did not see it (6:7, 20-25; 11:19). Faith rests on remembered acts of God.

decisions.choice: grandchildren
decisions.reason: "Your children's children" is "grandchildren" in plain English. Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase.

decisions.choice: yourselves
decisions.reason: Readable uses the plural, since Moses is speaking to the whole people; Literal and Balanced keep the singular form.

decisions.choice: singular "ten cuidado", "vigílate" at Readable too
alternatives: plural "tengan cuidado", as the English Readable "yourselves"
decisions.reason: The English Readable turns the Hebrew singular into a plural. Spanish has the singular "tú", which addresses the people as one without sounding like a single person only, so it keeps the Hebrew number at every level, as set for Deuteronomy at 1:8.

source.text: י֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָמַ֜דְתָּ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶיךָ֮ בְּחֹרֵב֒ בֶּאֱמֹ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י הַקְהֶל־לִי֙ אֶת־הָעָ֔ם וְאַשְׁמִעֵ֖ם אֶת־דְּבָרָ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִלְמְד֜וּן לְיִרְאָ֣ה אֹתִ֗י כָּל־הַיָּמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵ֤ם חַיִּים֙ עַל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וְאֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם יְלַמֵּדֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: [the] day that you stood before Yahweh your God at Horeb, when said Yahweh to me, assemble for me the people, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they [are] alive on the ground, and their children they may teach.

en.L: the day that you stood before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God at Horeb, when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'Assemble the people for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will make them hear {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words, so that they may learn to fear {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} all the days that they [are] alive on the ground, and [that] they may teach their {{gender:children|sons}}.'
en.B: above all the day you stood before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God at Horeb, when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'Gather the people to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will let them hear {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words. Then they will learn to fear {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as long as they live on the earth, and they will teach their {{gender:children|sons}} to do the same.'
en.R: Tell them about the day you stood in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God at Mount Horeb. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'Bring the people together in front of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. I will let them hear what I say. Then they will learn to honor and fear {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as long as they live on the earth. And they will teach their {{gender:children|sons}} to do the same.'

es.L: el día que estuviste delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios en Horeb, cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Reúne al pueblo para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y les haré oír {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras, para que aprendan a temerme todos los días que [estén] vivos sobre la tierra, y [para que] enseñen a sus hijos.”
es.B: sobre todo el día en que estuviste delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios en Horeb, cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Reúne al pueblo ante {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y les haré oír {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras. Así aprenderán a temerme mientras vivan en la tierra, y enseñarán a sus hijos a hacer lo mismo.”
es.R: Cuéntales del día en que estuviste delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios en el monte Horeb. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Reúne al pueblo delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. Voy a dejar que oigan lo que digo. Así aprenderán a honrarme y a temerme mientras vivan en la tierra. Y enseñarán a sus hijos a hacer lo mismo.”

fr.L: le jour où tu t’es tenu devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu à l’Horeb, quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Rassemble-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} le peuple, et je leur ferai entendre {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles, afin qu’ils apprennent à {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} craindre tous les jours qu’ils [seront] vivants sur le sol, et [qu’]ils [les] enseignent à leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}}.”
fr.B: surtout le jour où tu t’es tenu devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu à l’Horeb, quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Rassemble le peuple auprès de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et je leur ferai entendre {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles. Ainsi ils apprendront à {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} craindre aussi longtemps qu’ils vivront sur la terre, et ils l’enseigneront à leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}}.”
fr.R: Raconte-leur le jour où tu t’es tenu devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu au mont Horeb. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Rassemble le peuple devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Je vais leur faire entendre ce que je dis. Alors ils apprendront à {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} respecter et à {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} craindre toute leur vie sur la terre. Et ils apprendront à leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}} à faire de même.”

sw.L: siku ile uliposimama mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako huko Horebu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliponiambia, 'Unikusanyie watu, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawasikilizisha maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ili wajifunze kunicha siku zote watakazokuwa hai juu ya ardhi, na [ili] wawafundishe watoto wao.'
sw.B: hasa siku ile uliposimama mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako huko Horebu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliponiambia, 'Wakusanye watu {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawaacha wasikie maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. Ndipo watajifunza kunicha maadamu wanaishi duniani, nao watawafundisha watoto wao vivyo hivyo.'
sw.R: Wasimulie habari ya siku ile uliposimama mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kwenye Mlima Horebu. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniambia, 'Walete watu wakusanyike mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. Nitawaacha wasikie maneno ninayosema. Ndipo watajifunza kuniheshimu na kunicha maisha yao yote duniani. Nao watawafundisha watoto wao kufanya vivyo hivyo.'

decisions.choice: the day: the chief of the things Israel saw (verse 9)
decisions.reason: "The day" stands beside "the things" of verse 9 and names the greatest of them: the day at Horeb when God spoke.

decisions.choice: Horeb: the mountain called Sinai in Exodus
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy calls the mountain of the covenant Horeb (1:6; 5:2). Exodus 19 tells the same events at Mount Sinai.

decisions.choice: fear me: reverent awe that leads to obedience
decisions.reason: To fear God is to take him seriously, with awe and respect, and so to obey him (6:2, 13, 24; 10:12). It is a fear to be learned, not panic.

decisions.choice: above all
decisions.reason: Balanced adds "above all" so that the day at Horeb reads as the chief thing to be remembered and told, as the Hebrew means.

decisions.choice: Tell them about ... Mount Horeb
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence with "Tell them about", taking up "make them known" from verse 9, and says that Horeb is a mountain.

source.text: וַתִּקְרְב֥וּן וַתַּֽעַמְד֖וּן תַּ֣חַת הָהָ֑ר וְהָהָ֞ר בֹּעֵ֤ר בָּאֵשׁ֙ עַד־לֵ֣ב הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם חֹ֖שֶׁךְ עָנָ֥ן וַעֲרָפֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And you came near and stood under the mountain, and the mountain [was] burning with fire to [the] heart of the heavens: darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.

en.L: And you came near and stood under the mountain, and the mountain [was] burning with fire to the heart of the heavens: darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.
en.B: You drew near and stood at the base of the mountain. It was burning with fire up into the heart of the sky, wrapped in darkness, cloud, and deep gloom.
en.R: You came close and stood at the bottom of the mountain. Fire was blazing on the mountain, reaching high into the sky. All around it were darkness and cloud and thick blackness.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:se acercaron|os acercasteis}} y {{plural_you:se pusieron|os pusisteis}} debajo del monte, y el monte ardía en fuego hasta el corazón de los cielos: tinieblas, nube y densa oscuridad.
es.B: {{plural_you:Se acercaron|Os acercasteis}} y {{plural_you:se detuvieron|os detuvisteis}} al pie del monte. Ardía en llamas hasta lo más alto del cielo, envuelto en tinieblas, nubes y densa oscuridad.
es.R: {{plural_you:Se acercaron y se quedaron|Os acercasteis y os quedasteis}} al pie del monte. El fuego ardía sobre el monte y subía muy alto, hasta el cielo. Todo alrededor había oscuridad, nubes y una negrura espesa.

fr.L: Et vous vous êtes approchés et vous vous êtes tenus sous la montagne, et la montagne [était] brûlante de feu jusqu’au cœur des cieux : ténèbres, nuée et obscurité épaisse.
fr.B: Vous vous êtes approchés et vous vous êtes tenus au pied de la montagne. Elle brûlait d’un feu qui montait jusqu’au cœur du ciel, enveloppée de ténèbres, de nuée et d’une obscurité profonde.
fr.R: Vous vous êtes approchés et vous vous êtes arrêtés au pied de la montagne. Le feu flambait sur la montagne et montait très haut dans le ciel. Tout autour, il y avait l’obscurité, des nuages et un noir épais.

sw.L: Nanyi mkakaribia na kusimama chini ya mlima, na mlima [ulikuwa] ukiwaka moto hadi moyo wa mbingu: giza, wingu, na giza nene.
sw.B: Mlikaribia mkasimama mguuni mwa mlima. Ulikuwa ukiwaka moto hadi katikati ya anga, umefunikwa na giza, wingu na weusi mzito.
sw.R: Mlikaribia mkasimama chini kabisa ya mlima. Moto ulikuwa ukiwaka juu ya mlima, ukipanda juu sana angani. Pande zote kulikuwa na giza, mawingu na weusi mzito.

decisions.choice: to the heart of the heavens: high up into the sky
decisions.reason: The "heart" of something is its middle. The flames reached into the midst of the sky, as high as the eye could see.

decisions.choice: fire, cloud and thick darkness: the scene at Sinai
decisions.reason: Exodus 19:16-18 and 20:21 describe the same scene: smoke, fire, thunder and a thick cloud on the mountain where God came down. Moses repeats it in 5:22-23.

decisions.choice: darkness, cloud, and thick darkness: what surrounded the fire
decisions.reason: The three nouns stand loosely after the clause, describing the mountain: it burned with fire and was covered in darkness at the same time.

decisions.choice: at the base of / at the bottom of
decisions.reason: "Under the mountain" means at its foot. Balanced and Readable say so; Literal keeps "under".

source.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם מִתּ֣וֹךְ הָאֵ֑שׁ ק֤וֹל דְּבָרִים֙ אַתֶּ֣ם שֹׁמְעִ֔ים וּתְמוּנָ֛ה אֵינְכֶ֥ם רֹאִ֖ים זוּלָתִ֥י קֽוֹל׃

records.literal_gloss: And spoke Yahweh to you from [the] midst of the fire; [the] sound of words you [were] hearing, but a form not you [were] seeing, only a voice.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to you from the midst of the fire. The sound of words you [were] hearing, but a form you [were] not seeing; only a voice.
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to you out of the fire. You heard words being spoken, but you saw no form at all, only a voice.
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to you from the fire. You heard {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} speaking, but you did not see any shape. You only heard a voice.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} habló de en medio del fuego. El sonido de las palabras {{plural_you:oían|oíais}}, pero figura no {{plural_you:veían|veíais}}; solo una voz.
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} habló desde el fuego. {{plural_you:Oyeron|Oísteis}} el sonido de las palabras, pero no {{plural_you:vieron|visteis}} ninguna figura; solo había una voz.
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} habló desde el fuego. {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:oyeron|oísteis}} hablar, pero no {{plural_you:vieron|visteis}} ninguna forma. Solo {{plural_you:oyeron|oísteis}} una voz.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a parlé du milieu du feu. Le son des paroles, vous [l’]entendiez, mais une forme, vous n’en voyiez pas ; seulement une voix.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a parlé du milieu du feu. Vous entendiez des paroles, mais vous ne voyiez aucune forme : il n’y avait qu’une voix.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a parlé depuis le feu. Vous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avez entendu parler, mais vous n’avez vu aucune forme. Vous avez seulement entendu une voix.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema nanyi kutoka katikati ya moto. Sauti ya maneno mliisikia, lakini umbo hamkuliona; ila sauti tu.
sw.B: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema nanyi kutoka katika moto. Mlisikia sauti ya maneno, lakini hamkuona umbo lolote; mlisikia sauti tu.
sw.R: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema nanyi kutoka katika moto. Mlimsikia akisema, lakini hamkuona umbo lolote. Mlisikia sauti tu.

decisions.choice: form: a visible shape or likeness
decisions.reason: The word means the outline or appearance of something that can be seen (Numbers 12:8; Job 4:16). Israel saw fire, but no shape of God.

decisions.choice: sound, voice: one word for both
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses the same word for "sound" and "voice". What Israel had of God at Horeb was something heard, not something seen.

decisions.choice: you saw no form: the ground for the ban on images
decisions.reason: Because God showed himself by speaking and not by any visible shape, Israel must not make a shape to stand for him (verses 15-18).

decisions.choice: You heard him speaking
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "the sound of words" was: God speaking.

source.text: וַיַּגֵּ֨ד לָכֶ֜ם אֶת־בְּרִית֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה אֶתְכֶם֙ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת עֲשֶׂ֖רֶת הַדְּבָרִ֑ים וַֽיִּכְתְּבֵ֔ם עַל־שְׁנֵ֖י לֻח֥וֹת אֲבָנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he declared to you his covenant that he commanded you to do, the ten words; and he wrote them on two tablets of stones.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} declared to you {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant, which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} commanded you to do, the ten words; and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wrote them on two tablets of stone.
en.B: He made known to you {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant, the Ten Words, which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} commanded you to keep, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wrote them on two stone tablets.
en.R: He told you about {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant, the Ten Commandments, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} commanded you to obey them. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wrote them on two flat stones.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:les|os}} declaró {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto, que {{plural_you:les|os}} mandó cumplir, las diez palabras; y las escribió sobre dos tablas de piedra.
es.B: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} dio a conocer {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto, las Diez Palabras, que {{plural_you:les|os}} mandó cumplir, y las escribió en dos tablas de piedra.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} habló de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto, los Diez Mandamientos, y {{plural_you:les|os}} mandó obedecerlos. Luego los escribió en dos piedras planas.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous a déclaré {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous a commandé de pratiquer, les dix paroles ; et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a écrites sur deux tables de pierre.
fr.B: Il vous a fait connaître {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance, les Dix Paroles, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous a ordonné de mettre en pratique, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a écrites sur deux tables de pierre.
fr.R: Il vous a parlé de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance, les dix commandements, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous a ordonné de leur obéir. Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a écrits sur deux pierres plates.

sw.L: Naye aliwatangazia agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, ambalo aliwaamuru kulitenda, yale maneno kumi; {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akayaandika juu ya vibao viwili vya mawe.
sw.B: Aliwajulisha agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, yaani Maneno Kumi, aliyowaamuru kuyashika, kisha akayaandika juu ya vibao viwili vya mawe.
sw.R: Aliwaambia habari za agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, yaani Amri Kumi, akawaamuru kuzitii. Kisha akaziandika juu ya mawe mawili bapa.

decisions.choice: covenant: a binding agreement between God and his people
decisions.reason: A covenant binds two parties by promise and oath. At Horeb God bound himself to Israel and Israel to him, with the Ten Words as its terms (Exodus 24:3-8; 34:28).

decisions.choice: the ten words: the Ten Commandments
decisions.reason: This is the Hebrew name for the commands of Exodus 20:2-17, which Moses repeats in 5:6-21. "Words" here means sayings or commands (Exodus 34:28; Deuteronomy 10:4).

decisions.choice: to do the covenant: to keep its terms
decisions.reason: One "does" a covenant by living by what it requires.

decisions.choice: the ten words / the Ten Words / the Ten Commandments
decisions.reason: As at Exodus 34:28, Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew name; Readable uses the familiar one.

decisions.choice: two flat stones
decisions.reason: Readable says what the tablets were: flat pieces of stone to write on.

source.text: וְאֹתִ֞י צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא לְלַמֵּ֣ד אֶתְכֶ֔ם חֻקִּ֖ים וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֑ים לַעֲשֹׂתְכֶ֣ם אֹתָ֔ם בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And me commanded Yahweh at the time that to teach you statutes and judgments, for your doing them in the land where you [are] crossing there to take possession of it.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, for you to do them in the land that you [are] crossing into to take possession of it.
en.B: At that time {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded me to teach you statutes and rulings for you to follow in the land you are crossing over to take possession of.
en.R: At that time {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} told me to teach you laws and rules. You are to obey them in the land across the Jordan River that you are going to take possession of.

es.L: Y a mí me mandó {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en aquel tiempo {{plural_you:enseñarles|enseñaros}} estatutos y juicios, para que los {{plural_you:hicieran|hicierais}} en la tierra a la cual {{plural_you:pasan|pasáis}} para tomar posesión de ella.
es.B: En aquel tiempo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me mandó {{plural_you:enseñarles|enseñaros}} estatutos y normas para que los {{plural_you:cumplieran|cumplierais}} en la tierra a la que {{plural_you:van|vais}} a pasar para tomar posesión de ella.
es.R: En aquel tiempo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me mandó {{plural_you:enseñarles|enseñaros}} leyes y normas. {{plural_you:Deberán|Deberéis}} obedecerlas en la tierra que está al otro lado del río Jordán, la tierra que {{plural_you:van|vais}} a tomar como posesión.

fr.L: Et c’est à moi que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a commandé en ce temps-là de vous enseigner des prescriptions et des jugements, pour que vous les pratiquiez dans le pays où vous passez pour en prendre possession.
fr.B: En ce temps-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a ordonné de vous enseigner des prescriptions et des règles, pour que vous les suiviez dans le pays où vous allez passer pour en prendre possession.
fr.R: À ce moment-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a demandé de vous enseigner des lois et des règles. Vous devrez leur obéir dans le pays de l’autre côté du Jourdain, dont vous allez prendre possession.

sw.L: Na mimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniamuru wakati ule niwafundishe kanuni na hukumu, ili mzitende katika nchi mnayoivukia ili kuimiliki.
sw.B: Wakati ule {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniamuru niwafundishe kanuni na maagizo, ili myafuate katika nchi mnayovuka kwenda kuimiliki.
sw.R: Wakati ule {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniambia niwafundishe sheria na maagizo. Mtapaswa kuyatii katika nchi iliyo ng'ambo ya Mto Yordani, mtakayoimiliki.

decisions.choice: me: stressed, Moses' role set beside God's
decisions.reason: "Me" comes first for emphasis. God spoke the Ten Words to all the people himself; the rest of the statutes and rulings he gave through Moses (5:22-31).

decisions.choice: crossing there: crossing the Jordan into the land
decisions.reason: Israel is camped east of the Jordan. To "cross over" is to cross the river into Canaan (verses 21-22, 26).

decisions.choice: across the Jordan River
decisions.reason: Readable names the river that "crossing" refers to.

source.text: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם מְאֹ֖ד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹ֤א רְאִיתֶם֙ כָּל־תְּמוּנָ֔ה בְּי֗וֹם דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֲלֵיכֶ֛ם בְּחֹרֵ֖ב מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you shall guard exceedingly your souls, for not you saw any form on [the] day spoke Yahweh to you at Horeb from [the] midst of the fire,

en.L: And you shall guard your souls greatly, for you did not see any form on the day [that] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to you at Horeb from the midst of the fire,
en.B: Be very careful, then, for your own sake. On the day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to you at Horeb from the fire, you did not see any shape at all,
en.R: You did not see any shape on the day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to you from the fire at Mount Horeb. So be very careful!

es.L: Y {{plural_you:guardarán|guardaréis}} mucho {{plural_you:sus almas|vuestras almas}}, porque no {{plural_you:vieron|visteis}} ninguna figura el día [en que] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} habló en Horeb de en medio del fuego,
es.B: Así que {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} mucho cuidado, por {{plural_you:su propio bien|vuestro propio bien}}. El día en que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} habló en Horeb desde el fuego, no {{plural_you:vieron|visteis}} ninguna figura,
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes no vieron|Vosotros no visteis}} ninguna forma el día en que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} habló desde el fuego en el monte Horeb. ¡Así que {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} mucho cuidado!

fr.L: Et vous garderez bien vos âmes, car vous n’avez vu aucune forme le jour où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a parlé à l’Horeb du milieu du feu,
fr.B: Soyez donc très prudents, pour votre propre bien. Le jour où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a parlé à l’Horeb du milieu du feu, vous n’avez vu aucune forme,
fr.R: Vous n’avez vu aucune forme le jour où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a parlé depuis le feu, au mont Horeb. Alors faites très attention !

sw.L: Nanyi mtazilinda nafsi zenu sana, kwa maana hamkuona umbo lolote siku ile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliposema nanyi huko Horebu kutoka katikati ya moto,
sw.B: Basi jihadharini sana kwa ajili ya nafsi zenu. Siku ile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliposema nanyi huko Horebu kutoka katika moto, hamkuona umbo lolote,
sw.R: Hamkuona umbo lolote siku ile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliposema nanyi kutoka katika moto kwenye Mlima Horebu. Kwa hiyo jihadharini sana!

decisions.choice: your souls: yourselves
decisions.reason: As in verse 9, "soul" means the self. The warning is to watch over oneself closely.

decisions.choice: you saw no form: the reason for what follows
decisions.reason: God revealed himself at Horeb by voice, not by any visible shape. So no shape may be made to stand for him (verses 16-18).

decisions.choice: You did not see ... So be very careful!
decisions.reason: Readable gives the reason first and the warning after it, which is easier to follow in short sentences.

source.text: פֶּ֨ן־תַּשְׁחִת֔וּן וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֥ם לָכֶ֛ם פֶּ֖סֶל תְּמוּנַ֣ת כָּל־סָ֑מֶל תַּבְנִ֥ית זָכָ֖ר א֥וֹ נְקֵבָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: lest you act corruptly and make for yourselves a carved image, [the] form of any figure, [the] likeness of male or female,

en.L: lest you act corruptly and make for yourselves a carved image, the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
en.B: so do not bring ruin on yourselves by making an idol for yourselves in the form of any figure, the likeness of a man or a woman,
en.R: Do not ruin yourselves by making an idol of any shape, whether it looks like a man or a woman,

es.L: no sea que {{plural_you:se corrompan|os corrompáis}} y {{plural_you:se hagan|os hagáis}} una imagen tallada, figura de cualquier forma, semejanza de varón o de hembra,
es.B: así que no {{plural_you:se arruinen|os arruinéis}} {{plural_you:haciéndose|haciéndoos}} un ídolo con la forma de cualquier figura, la imagen de un hombre o de una mujer,
es.R: No {{plural_you:se arruinen|os arruinéis}} haciendo un ídolo de ninguna forma, ya sea que parezca un hombre o una mujer,

fr.L: de peur que vous ne vous corrompiez et que vous ne vous fassiez une image taillée, la forme de quelque figure que ce soit, la ressemblance d’un mâle ou d’une femelle,
fr.B: ne vous perdez donc pas en vous faisant une idole qui ait la forme d’une figure quelconque, l’image d’un homme ou d’une femme,
fr.R: Ne vous perdez pas en fabriquant une idole, quelle que soit sa forme, qu’elle ressemble à un homme ou à une femme,

sw.L: msije mkajiharibu na kujifanyia sanamu ya kuchonga, umbo la mfano wowote, mfano wa kiume au wa kike,
sw.B: basi msijiletee maangamizi kwa kujifanyia sanamu yenye umbo la kitu chochote, mfano wa mwanamume au mwanamke,
sw.R: Msijiangamize kwa kutengeneza sanamu ya umbo lolote, iwe inafanana na mwanamume au mwanamke,

decisions.choice: act corruptly: ruin yourselves, go to destruction
decisions.reason: The verb means to spoil or destroy. Making an idol would corrupt Israel's worship and bring ruin on the people (9:12; 31:29).

decisions.choice: carved image: an idol shaped by a craftsman
decisions.reason: The word comes from a verb meaning to carve or hew. It names an idol made of wood, stone or metal (5:8; Exodus 20:4).

decisions.choice: figure: a statue or image
decisions.reason: The word is rare (Ezekiel 8:3, 5). With "form" and "likeness" it shuts out every kind of image, of any shape.

decisions.choice: a man or a woman
decisions.reason: "Male or female" is put in everyday words.

source.text: תַּבְנִ֕ית כָּל־בְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּאָ֑רֶץ תַּבְנִית֙ כָּל־צִפּ֣וֹר כָּנָ֔ף אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּע֖וּף בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: [the] likeness of any animal that [is] on the earth, [the] likeness of any bird of wing that flies in the heavens,

en.L: the likeness of any animal that [is] on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the heavens,
en.B: the likeness of any beast on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies through the sky,
en.R: or like any animal on land or any bird that flies in the sky,

es.L: semejanza de cualquier animal que [está] en la tierra, semejanza de cualquier ave alada que vuela en los cielos,
es.B: la imagen de cualquier bestia de la tierra, la imagen de cualquier ave alada que vuela por el cielo,
es.R: o como cualquier animal de la tierra o cualquier ave que vuela en el cielo,

fr.L: la ressemblance de toute bête qui [est] sur la terre, la ressemblance de tout oiseau ailé qui vole dans les cieux,
fr.B: l’image de n’importe quelle bête de la terre, l’image de n’importe quel oiseau ailé qui vole dans le ciel,
fr.R: ou à un animal de la terre, ou à un oiseau qui vole dans le ciel,

sw.L: mfano wa mnyama yeyote aliye juu ya nchi, mfano wa ndege yeyote mwenye mabawa arukaye katika mbingu,
sw.B: mfano wa mnyama yeyote wa nchi, mfano wa ndege yeyote mwenye mabawa arukaye angani,
sw.R: au mnyama yeyote wa nchi kavu au ndege yeyote arukaye angani,

decisions.choice: the list of creatures: the order of creation in reverse
decisions.reason: Verses 16-19 run from humans to land animals, birds, creeping things, fish and then the sun, moon and stars, the creation of Genesis 1:14-27 in reverse. Nothing God made may be worshiped in his place (Romans 1:23).

decisions.choice: animal: any four-footed beast of the land
decisions.reason: The word often means cattle and other domestic animals, but here it stands for every kind of land animal.

decisions.choice: sky
decisions.reason: "The heavens" where birds fly is the sky. Literal keeps "heavens".

source.text: תַּבְנִ֕ית כָּל־רֹמֵ֖שׂ בָּאֲדָמָ֑ה תַּבְנִ֛ית כָּל־דָּגָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־בַּמַּ֖יִם מִתַּ֥חַת לָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: [the] likeness of any creeping [thing] on the ground, [the] likeness of any fish that [is] in the waters under the earth.

en.L: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that [is] in the waters under the earth.
en.B: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish in the waters beneath the land.
en.R: or any creature that crawls on the ground, or any fish in the water.

es.L: semejanza de cualquier [cosa] que se arrastra sobre el suelo, semejanza de cualquier pez que [está] en las aguas debajo de la tierra.
es.B: la imagen de cualquier animal que se arrastra por el suelo, la imagen de cualquier pez de las aguas que están debajo de la tierra.
es.R: o cualquier animal que se arrastra por el suelo, o cualquier pez del agua.

fr.L: la ressemblance de toute [bête] qui rampe sur le sol, la ressemblance de tout poisson qui [est] dans les eaux sous la terre.
fr.B: l’image de n’importe quelle bête qui rampe sur le sol, l’image de n’importe quel poisson des eaux qui sont plus bas que la terre.
fr.R: ou à une bête qui rampe sur le sol, ou à un poisson dans l’eau.

sw.L: mfano wa kitu chochote kitambaacho juu ya ardhi, mfano wa samaki yeyote aliye katika maji chini ya nchi.
sw.B: mfano wa kiumbe chochote kitambaacho ardhini, mfano wa samaki yeyote katika maji yaliyo chini ya nchi.
sw.R: au kiumbe chochote kitambaacho ardhini, au samaki yeyote majini.

decisions.choice: creeping thing: small creatures that move close to the ground
decisions.reason: The word covers insects, reptiles and other small animals that creep or crawl (Genesis 1:24-25).

decisions.choice: the waters under the earth: seas, lakes and rivers lower than the land
decisions.reason: The phrase does not mean an underworld. Water lies below the level of the land, and fish live there (5:8; Exodus 20:4).

decisions.choice: in the water
decisions.reason: Readable leaves out "under the earth", which could mislead a young reader; the fish are simply in the water.

source.text: וּפֶן־תִּשָּׂ֨א עֵינֶ֜יךָ הַשָּׁמַ֗יְמָה וְֽ֠רָאִיתָ אֶת־הַשֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ וְאֶת־הַיָּרֵ֜חַ וְאֶת־הַכּֽוֹכָבִ֗ים כֹּ֚ל צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְנִדַּחְתָּ֛ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם וַעֲבַדְתָּ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָלַ֜ק יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ אֹתָ֔ם לְכֹל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים תַּ֖חַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And lest you lift up your eyes to the heavens and see the sun and the moon and the stars, all [the] host of the heavens, and you be drawn away and bow down to them and serve them, which has allotted Yahweh your God to all the peoples under all the heavens.

en.L: And lest you lift up your eyes to the heavens and see the sun and the moon and the stars, all the host of the heavens, and you be drawn away and bow down to them and serve them, which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has allotted to all the peoples under all the heavens.
en.B: Do not raise your eyes to the sky and, seeing the sun, the moon, and the stars, all the host of heaven, be drawn away to bow down to them and serve them. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God has allotted them to all the peoples under the whole sky.
en.R: And when you look up into the sky and see the sun, moon, and stars, do not be tempted to bow down and worship them. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God has given them to all the peoples everywhere under the sky.

es.L: Y no sea que alces tus ojos a los cielos y veas el sol y la luna y las estrellas, todo el ejército de los cielos, y seas arrastrado y te postres ante ellos y los sirvas, los cuales {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios ha repartido a todos los pueblos debajo de todos los cielos.
es.B: No levantes los ojos al cielo para que, al ver el sol, la luna y las estrellas, todo el ejército del cielo, te dejes arrastrar a inclinarte ante ellos y darles culto. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios los ha repartido a todos los pueblos bajo el cielo entero.
es.R: Y cuando mires al cielo y veas el sol, la luna y las estrellas, no te dejes tentar a inclinarte ante ellos y adorarlos. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios se los ha dado a todos los pueblos que viven bajo el cielo.

fr.L: Et de peur que tu ne lèves tes yeux vers les cieux et que tu ne voies le soleil, la lune et les étoiles, toute l’armée des cieux, et que tu ne te laisses entraîner à te prosterner devant eux et à les servir, eux que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu a attribués en partage à tous les peuples sous tous les cieux.
fr.B: Ne lève pas les yeux vers le ciel pour voir le soleil, la lune et les étoiles, toute l’armée du ciel, et te laisser entraîner à te prosterner devant eux et à les servir. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu les a donnés en partage à tous les peuples sous le ciel entier.
fr.R: Et quand tu regardes le ciel et que tu vois le soleil, la lune et les étoiles, ne te laisse pas tenter de te prosterner devant eux et de les adorer. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu les a donnés à tous les peuples, partout sous le ciel.

sw.L: Na usije ukainua macho yako kuelekea mbinguni na kuona jua na mwezi na nyota, jeshi lote la mbinguni, ukashawishiwa ukavisujudia na kuvitumikia, ambavyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amewagawia watu wa mataifa yote chini ya mbingu zote.
sw.B: Usiinue macho yako kuelekea angani, na ukiona jua, mwezi na nyota, jeshi lote la mbinguni, ukavutwa kuvisujudia na kuvitumikia. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amewagawia mataifa yote chini ya anga lote.
sw.R: Unapotazama juu angani ukaona jua, mwezi na nyota, usikubali kushawishiwa kuviinamia na kuviabudu. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amewapa watu wote kila mahali chini ya mbingu.

decisions.choice: the host of the heavens: the sun, moon and stars, seen as an army
decisions.reason: "Host" means an army or a great company. The heavenly bodies were counted as a vast host, and many nations worshiped them as gods (17:3; 2 Kings 21:3, 5).

decisions.choice: drawn away: pulled aside, led astray
decisions.reason: The verb means to be pushed or drawn away from the right path. The beauty of the sky could lure Israel into worshiping what God made.

decisions.choice: allotted to all the peoples: given to all nations for their use, or left to them as their gods
alternatives: given to all peoples as lights
left to the nations as objects of their worship
decisions.reason: The verb means to divide out shares. It may mean that God gave the sun, moon and stars to all peoples alike, as lights (Genesis 1:14-18), so they are no god of Israel's. Or it may mean that God left the nations to worship them, while he took Israel as his own (verse 20; 29:25; 32:8-9). The words allow both.

decisions.choice: worship
decisions.reason: Readable says "worship" for "serve", which here means serving as gods.

decisions.choice: Do not raise your eyes ... / do not be tempted
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn "lest" into a direct warning and give what God has done with the sky a sentence of its own.

source.text: וְאֶתְכֶם֙ לָקַ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה וַיּוֹצִ֥א אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִכּ֥וּר הַבַּרְזֶ֖ל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם לִהְי֥וֹת ל֛וֹ לְעַ֥ם נַחֲלָ֖ה כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: But you took Yahweh and brought out you from the furnace of iron, from Egypt, to be for him a people of inheritance, as [this] day this.

en.L: But you {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} took, and brought you out of the furnace of iron, out of Egypt, to be a people of inheritance for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, as [it is] this day.
en.B: But you are the ones {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} took and brought out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own people, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} inheritance, as you are today.
en.R: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} took you and rescued you from Egypt, where you suffered as if you were in a blazing furnace. He did this so that you would be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} very own people, as you are today.

es.L: Pero a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los|os}} tomó, y {{plural_you:los|os}} sacó del horno de hierro, de Egipto, para que {{plural_you:fueran|fuerais}} para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} un pueblo de heredad, como [lo {{plural_you:son|sois}}] este día.
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes son|vosotros sois}} los que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tomó y sacó del horno de hierro, de Egipto, para que {{plural_you:fueran|fuerais}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio pueblo, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} heredad, como lo {{plural_you:son|sois}} hoy.
es.R: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los tomó a ustedes|os tomó a vosotros}} y {{plural_you:los|os}} rescató de Egipto, donde {{plural_you:sufrían|sufríais}} como si {{plural_you:estuvieran|estuvierais}} en un horno ardiente. Lo hizo para que {{plural_you:fueran|fuerais}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, solo de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, como lo {{plural_you:son|sois}} hoy.

fr.L: Mais vous, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a pris, et vous a fait sortir de la fournaise de fer, de l’Égypte, pour que vous soyez pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} un peuple d’héritage, comme [c’est le cas] en ce jour.
fr.B: Mais vous, vous êtes ceux que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a pris et fait sortir de la fournaise de fer, de l’Égypte, pour que vous soyez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} héritage, comme vous l’êtes aujourd’hui.
fr.R: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a pris et vous a délivrés de l’Égypte, où vous souffriez comme dans une fournaise ardente. Il l’a fait pour que vous soyez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, comme vous l’êtes aujourd’hui.

sw.L: Lakini ninyi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwatwaa, akawatoa katika tanuru la chuma, kutoka Misri, ili mwe watu wa urithi {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, kama [ilivyo] siku hii.
sw.B: Lakini ninyi ndio wale ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwachukua na kuwatoa katika tanuru la chuma, kutoka Misri, ili mwe watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe, urithi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, kama mlivyo leo.
sw.R: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwachukua akawaokoa kutoka Misri, mahali mlipoteseka kana kwamba mko katika tanuru la moto mkali. Alifanya hivyo ili mwe watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kabisa, kama mlivyo leo.

decisions.choice: But you: Israel set against the peoples of verse 19
decisions.reason: "You" comes first for emphasis. The nations have the sky; Israel the LORD took for himself.

decisions.choice: the iron furnace: Egypt as a place of fierce suffering
decisions.reason: A furnace for smelting iron burned very hot. The picture is of the harsh slavery of Egypt, and perhaps of testing that refines (1 Kings 8:51; Jeremiah 11:4).

decisions.choice: a people of inheritance: a people who belong to God as his own possession
decisions.reason: The word for inheritance names family property handed down and kept for good. Israel is God's lasting possession (9:26, 29; 32:9).

decisions.choice: But you are the ones ...
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the stress on "you" with "you are the ones".

decisions.choice: where you suffered as if you were in a blazing furnace
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the iron furnace.

source.text: וַֽיהוָ֥ה הִתְאַנֶּף־בִּ֖יעַל־דִּבְרֵיכֶ֑ם וַיִּשָּׁבַ֗ע לְבִלְתִּ֤י עָבְרִי֙ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וּלְבִלְתִּי־בֹא֙ אֶל־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ נַחֲלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And Yahweh was angry with me on account of your words, and he swore that not I would cross the Jordan and not go into the land good that Yahweh your God [is] giving to you [as] an inheritance.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was angry with me on account of your words, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} swore that I would not cross the Jordan and would not go into the good land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God [is] giving you [as] an inheritance.
en.B: Because of you, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was angry with me and swore that I would not go over the Jordan or come into the good land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you as an inheritance.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} was angry with me because of you. He swore that I would never cross the Jordan River and go into the good land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you to keep as your own.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se enojó conmigo a causa de {{plural_you:las palabras de ustedes|vuestras palabras}}, y juró que yo no pasaría el Jordán y no entraría en la buena tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da [como] heredad.
es.B: Por causa de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se enojó conmigo y juró que yo no cruzaría el Jordán ni entraría en la buena tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da como heredad.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se enojó conmigo por culpa de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Juró que yo nunca cruzaría el río Jordán ni entraría en la buena tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da para que sea tuya.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est irrité contre moi à cause de vos paroles, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a juré que je ne passerais pas le Jourdain et que je n’entrerais pas dans le bon pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne [en] héritage.
fr.B: À cause de vous, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est irrité contre moi et a juré que je ne traverserais pas le Jourdain et que je n’entrerais pas dans le bon pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne en héritage.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est mis en colère contre moi à cause de vous. Il a juré que je ne traverserais jamais le Jourdain et que je n’entrerais pas dans le bon pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne pour qu’il soit à toi.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinikasirikia kwa ajili ya maneno yenu, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akaapa kwamba sitavuka Yordani wala sitaingia katika nchi nzuri ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa [iwe] urithi.
sw.B: Kwa sababu yenu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinikasirikia, akaapa kwamba sitavuka Yordani wala kuingia katika nchi nzuri ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa iwe urithi.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinikasirikia kwa sababu yenu. Aliapa kwamba sitavuka kamwe Mto Yordani na kuingia katika nchi nzuri ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa iwe yako.

decisions.choice: on account of your words: because of you, because of what you did
decisions.reason: "Words" can mean matters or affairs. Moses says, as in 1:37 and 3:26, that it was because of the people that he too may not enter.

decisions.choice: the LORD was angry and swore: the judgment at Meribah
decisions.reason: Numbers 20:2-13 tells how, when the people complained for water, Moses and Aaron did not honor God as holy, and God said they would not bring the people into the land. Deuteronomy stresses the people's part in it.

decisions.choice: inheritance: a lasting family possession
decisions.reason: The land is given as property to be handed down from generation to generation, as in verse 20.

decisions.choice: because of you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom; Literal keeps "on account of your words".

source.text: כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֥י מֵת֙ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את אֵינֶ֥נִּי עֹבֵ֖ר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְאַתֶּם֙ עֹֽבְרִ֔ים וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֕ם אֶת־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: For I [am] dying in the land this; not I [am] crossing the Jordan; but you [are] crossing and will take possession of the land good this.

en.L: For I [am] dying in this land; I [am] not crossing the Jordan; but you [are] crossing over, and you will take possession of this good land.
en.B: I must die here in this land and not cross the Jordan, but you are going over, and you will take possession of this good land.
en.R: I am going to die here in this land. I will not cross the Jordan River. But you will go across and take possession of that good land.

es.L: Porque yo muero en esta tierra; no cruzo el Jordán; pero {{plural_you:ustedes cruzan|vosotros cruzáis}} y {{plural_you:tomarán|tomaréis}} posesión de esta buena tierra.
