es.B: Yo he de morir aquí, en esta tierra, sin cruzar el Jordán; pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} sí lo {{plural_you:cruzarán|cruzaréis}} y {{plural_you:tomarán|tomaréis}} posesión de esta buena tierra.
es.R: Yo voy a morir aquí, en esta tierra. No cruzaré el río Jordán. Pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} sí {{plural_you:pasarán|pasaréis}} al otro lado y {{plural_you:tomarán|tomaréis}} posesión de aquella buena tierra.

fr.L: Car moi, je meurs dans ce pays ; je ne passe pas le Jourdain ; mais vous, vous passez, et vous prendrez possession de ce bon pays.
fr.B: Je dois mourir ici, dans ce pays, sans passer le Jourdain ; mais vous, vous allez le traverser et vous prendrez possession de ce bon pays.
fr.R: Je vais mourir ici, dans ce pays. Je ne traverserai pas le Jourdain. Mais vous, vous allez le traverser, et vous prendrez possession de ce bon pays, là-bas.

sw.L: Kwa maana mimi ninakufa katika nchi hii; sivuki Yordani; lakini ninyi mnavuka, nanyi mtaimiliki nchi hii nzuri.
sw.B: Mimi nitakufa hapa katika nchi hii bila kuvuka Yordani, lakini ninyi mnakwenda kuvuka, nanyi mtaimiliki nchi hii nzuri.
sw.R: Mimi nitakufa hapa katika nchi hii. Sitavuka Mto Yordani. Lakini ninyi mtavuka na kuimiliki ile nchi nzuri.

decisions.choice: dying ... crossing: what is about to happen
decisions.reason: The verbs describe events close at hand: Moses will soon die (34:5), and the people will soon cross.

decisions.choice: this land: Moab, east of the Jordan, where Moses is speaking
decisions.reason: The first "this land" is where Moses stands. The second, "this good land", is Canaan across the river, the land everyone is thinking of.

decisions.choice: that good land
decisions.reason: Readable says "that" for the land across the river, so readers do not confuse it with the land where Moses will die.

source.text: הִשָּׁמְר֣וּ לָכֶ֗ם פֶּֽן־תִּשְׁכְּחוּ֙ אֶת־בְּרִ֤ית יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖ת עִמָּכֶ֑ם וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם לָכֶ֥ם פֶּ֨סֶל֙ תְּמ֣וּנַת כֹּ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Take heed to yourselves lest you forget [the] covenant of Yahweh your God that he made with you, and make for yourselves a carved image, [the] form of anything that commanded you Yahweh your God.

en.L: Take heed to yourselves, lest you forget the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made with you, and make for yourselves a carved image, the form of anything that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has commanded you [not to make].
en.B: Watch yourselves, so that you do not forget the covenant {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God made with you by making yourselves an idol shaped like anything at all, which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has forbidden you.
en.R: Be careful! Do not forget the covenant {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God made with you. Do not make an idol shaped like anything at all. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God has told you not to do that.

es.L: {{plural_you:Cuídense ustedes mismos|Guardaos vosotros mismos}}, no sea que {{plural_you:olviden|olvidéis}} el pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} que hizo con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:se hagan|os hagáis}} una imagen tallada, figura de cualquier cosa que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha mandado [no hacer].
es.B: {{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado, no sea que {{plural_you:olviden|olvidéis}} el pacto que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} hizo con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:haciéndose|haciéndoos}} un ídolo con la forma de cualquier cosa, lo cual {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha prohibido.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado! No {{plural_you:olviden|olvidéis}} el pacto que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} hizo con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. No {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} ningún ídolo con forma de nada. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha dicho que no lo hagas.

fr.L: Prenez garde à vous, de peur que vous n’oubliiez l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a conclue avec vous, et que vous ne vous fassiez une image taillée, la forme de quoi que ce soit, ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a commandé [de ne pas faire].
fr.B: Veillez sur vous-mêmes, pour ne pas oublier l’alliance que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu a conclue avec vous en vous faisant une idole de quelque forme que ce soit, ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a interdit.
fr.R: Faites attention ! N’oubliez pas l’alliance que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu a conclue avec vous. Ne fabriquez aucune idole, quelle que soit sa forme. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a dit de ne pas le faire.

sw.L: Jihadharini wenyewe, msije mkalisahau agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu alilofanya nanyi, mkajifanyia sanamu ya kuchonga, umbo la kitu chochote ambacho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekuamuru [usifanye].
sw.B: Jilindeni, msije mkalisahau agano ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu alifanya nanyi, kwa kujifanyia sanamu yenye umbo la kitu chochote, jambo ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekukataza.
sw.R: Jihadharini! Msilisahau agano ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu alifanya nanyi. Msitengeneze sanamu yenye umbo la kitu chochote. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekuambia usifanye hivyo.

decisions.choice: that the LORD commanded you: what he commanded you about, that is, forbade
decisions.reason: The clause refers to the command against images (verse 16; 5:8). What God "commanded" concerning them is that they must not be made.

decisions.choice: made a covenant: literally "cut" a covenant
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is "cut", perhaps from the cutting of animals in covenant rites (Genesis 15:9-18). It is the usual way to say "make a covenant".

decisions.choice: forgetting the covenant and making an image: one sin, not two
decisions.reason: To make an image is to forget the covenant, whose first terms forbid other gods and images (5:7-10).

decisions.choice: which the LORD your God has forbidden you / told you not to do that
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say outright that the command was a prohibition. Literal keeps "commanded".

source.text: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֵ֥שׁ אֹכְלָ֖ה ה֑וּא אֵ֖ל קַנָּֽא׃פ

records.literal_gloss: For Yahweh your God, a fire consuming he [is], a God jealous.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] a consuming fire, a jealous God.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is a devouring fire, a God who is jealous.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God is like a fire that burns up everything. He is a jealous God, who wants you to worship only {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] fuego consumidor, Dios celoso.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios es un fuego devorador, un Dios celoso.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios es como un fuego que lo quema todo. Es un Dios celoso, que quiere que lo adores solo a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [est] un feu dévorant, un Dieu jaloux.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu est un feu qui dévore, un Dieu jaloux.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu est comme un feu qui brûle tout. C’est un Dieu jaloux, qui veut que tu n’adores que {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ni] moto ulao, Mungu mwenye wivu.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako ni moto unaoteketeza, Mungu mwenye wivu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako ni kama moto unaoteketeza kila kitu. Ni Mungu mwenye wivu, anayetaka umwabudu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} peke yake.

decisions.choice: a consuming fire: his holiness destroys what sets itself against him
decisions.reason: God appeared at Horeb in fire (verses 11-12). The fire that showed his presence is also a picture of his judgment on those who turn from him (9:3; Exodus 24:17; Hebrews 12:29).

decisions.choice: jealous: zealous for the loyalty that belongs to him alone
decisions.reason: The word describes the passion of one who will not share what is rightly his, like a husband's claim on his wife's faithfulness. It is not petty envy but God's demand for undivided worship (5:9; Exodus 20:5; 34:14).

decisions.choice: who wants you to worship only him
decisions.reason: Readable explains what God's jealousy is about, so young readers do not take it as envy.

decisions.choice: like a fire
decisions.reason: Readable marks the fire as a picture.

source.text: כִּֽי־תוֹלִ֤יד בָּנִים֙ וּבְנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים וְנוֹשַׁנְתֶּ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְהִשְׁחַתֶּ֗ם וַעֲשִׂ֤יתֶם פֶּ֨סֶל֙ תְּמ֣וּנַת כֹּ֔ל וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֥ם הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה־אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לְהַכְעִיסֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: When you father children and children of children, and you have grown old in the land, and you act corruptly and make a carved image, [the] form of anything, and do the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh your God to provoke him,

en.L: When you father {{gender:children|sons}} and {{gender:children's children|sons' sons}}, and you have grown old in the land, and you act corruptly and make a carved image, the form of anything, and do the evil in the eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, to provoke {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to anger,
en.B: When you have had {{gender:children|sons}} and {{gender:grandchildren|grandsons}} and have grown old in the land, and you act corruptly and make an idol in the form of anything, doing what is evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and provoking {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to anger,
en.R: In the future you will have {{gender:children|sons}} and {{gender:grandchildren|grandsons}}, and you will live in the land a long time. Then you might ruin yourselves by making an idol of some kind. You would be doing what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God says is evil, and you would make {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} angry.

es.L: Cuando engendres hijos e hijos de hijos, y {{plural_you:hayan envejecido|hayáis envejecido}} en la tierra, y {{plural_you:se corrompan|os corrompáis}} y {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} una imagen tallada, figura de cualquier cosa, y {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, para provocarlo a ira,
es.B: Cuando hayas tenido hijos y nietos y {{plural_you:hayan|hayáis}} envejecido en la tierra, si {{plural_you:se corrompen|os corrompéis}} y {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} un ídolo con forma de cualquier cosa, haciendo lo que es malo ante los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios y provocándolo a ira,
es.R: En el futuro tendrás hijos y nietos, y {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}} mucho tiempo en la tierra. Entonces {{plural_you:podrían arruinarse|podríais arruinaros}} haciendo algún ídolo. {{plural_you:Estarían|Estaríais}} haciendo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios dice que es malo, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:harían|haríais}} enojar.

fr.L: Quand tu engendreras des {{gender:enfants|fils}} et les {{gender:enfants de tes enfants|fils de tes fils}}, et que vous aurez vieilli dans le pays, et que vous vous corromprez et ferez une image taillée, la forme de quoi que ce soit, et ferez ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}irriter,
fr.B: Quand tu auras eu des {{gender:enfants|fils}} et des {{gender:petits-enfants|petits-fils}}, et que vous aurez vieilli dans le pays, si vous vous corrompez en faisant une idole de quelque forme que ce soit, en faisant ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu et en {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}irritant,
fr.R: Plus tard, tu auras des {{gender:enfants|fils}} et des {{gender:petits-enfants|petits-fils}}, et vous vivrez longtemps dans le pays. Alors vous pourriez vous perdre en fabriquant une idole, quelle qu’elle soit. Vous feriez ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu appelle mal, et vous {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} mettriez en colère.

sw.L: Utakapozaa watoto na watoto wa watoto, nanyi mkiwa mmezeeka katika nchi, mkajiharibu na kufanya sanamu ya kuchonga, umbo la kitu chochote, na kufanya yaliyo maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, ili kumkasirisha,
sw.B: Utakapokuwa umepata watoto na wajukuu, nanyi mkiwa mmekaa muda mrefu katika nchi, mkijiharibu kwa kufanya sanamu yenye umbo la kitu chochote, mkitenda yaliyo maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako na kumkasirisha,
sw.R: Siku zijazo utakuwa na watoto na wajukuu, nanyi mtaishi katika nchi muda mrefu. Ndipo mnaweza kujiharibu kwa kutengeneza sanamu ya aina fulani. Mtakuwa mnafanya yale ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anasema ni maovu, nanyi mtamkasirisha.

decisions.choice: grown old: settled long in the land, and grown used to it
decisions.reason: The verb means to become old or long-established. After generations in the land, the danger is that the memory of Horeb fades (6:10-12; 8:11-14).

decisions.choice: when: a real danger Moses sees ahead
decisions.reason: The sentence describes what may happen and what will follow if it does. Later Moses speaks of it as what will happen (31:16-21, 29).

decisions.choice: do the evil in the eyes of the LORD: do what he judges evil
decisions.reason: "In the eyes of" means in someone's judgment. The phrase becomes the standard verdict on Israel's idolatry (Judges 2:11; 2 Kings 17:17).

decisions.choice: grandchildren
decisions.reason: As in verse 9: "children's children" is "grandchildren".

source.text: הַעִידֹתִי֩ בָכֶ֨ם הַיּ֜וֹם אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־הָאָ֗רֶץ כִּֽי־אָבֹ֣ד תֹּאבֵדוּן֮ מַהֵר֒ מֵעַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֧ים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ לֹֽא־תַאֲרִיכֻ֤ן יָמִים֙ עָלֶ֔יהָ כִּ֥י הִשָּׁמֵ֖ד תִּשָּׁמֵדֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: I call as witness against you today the heavens and the earth, that perishing you will perish quickly from on the land where you [are] crossing the Jordan there to take possession of it; not you will prolong days on it, for being destroyed you will be destroyed.

en.L: I call the heavens and the earth to witness against you today that you will surely perish quickly from the land that you [are] crossing the Jordan into to take possession of it. You will not prolong [your] days on it, for you will surely be destroyed.
en.B: Today I call heaven and earth to testify against you: you will soon be wiped out from the land you are crossing the Jordan to take possession of. You will not live long in it; you will be utterly destroyed.
en.R: Today I am calling the sky and the earth to be witnesses against you. If you do that, you will soon be gone from the land you are crossing the Jordan River to take possession of. You will not live there long. You will be completely destroyed.

es.L: Pongo hoy por testigos contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} a los cielos y a la tierra, de que ciertamente {{plural_you:perecerán|pereceréis}} pronto de sobre la tierra adonde {{plural_you:cruzan|cruzáis}} el Jordán para tomar posesión de ella. No {{plural_you:prolongarán|prolongaréis}} [{{plural_you:sus|vuestros}}] días sobre ella, porque ciertamente {{plural_you:serán destruidos|seréis destruidos}}.
es.B: Hoy pongo al cielo y a la tierra como testigos contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: pronto {{plural_you:desaparecerán|desapareceréis}} de la tierra que {{plural_you:van|vais}} a poseer al otro lado del Jordán. No {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}} mucho en ella; {{plural_you:serán exterminados|seréis exterminados}} por completo.
es.R: Hoy llamo al cielo y a la tierra como testigos contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Si {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} eso, pronto {{plural_you:desaparecerán|desapareceréis}} de la tierra que {{plural_you:van|vais}} a tomar al otro lado del río Jordán. No {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}} allí mucho tiempo. {{plural_you:Serán destruidos|Seréis destruidos}} por completo.

fr.L: J’appelle aujourd’hui à témoin contre vous les cieux et la terre, que vous disparaîtrez assurément bientôt du pays où vous passez le Jourdain pour en prendre possession. Vous n’y prolongerez pas [vos] jours, car vous serez assurément détruits.
fr.B: Aujourd’hui je prends le ciel et la terre à témoin contre vous : vous serez bientôt rayés du pays dont vous allez prendre possession en passant le Jourdain. Vous n’y vivrez pas longtemps ; vous serez complètement détruits.
fr.R: Aujourd’hui, j’appelle le ciel et la terre à être témoins contre vous. Si vous faites cela, vous disparaîtrez bientôt du pays dont vous allez prendre possession de l’autre côté du Jourdain. Vous n’y vivrez pas longtemps. Vous serez complètement détruits.

sw.L: Ninaziita mbingu na nchi kuwa mashahidi juu yenu leo, kwamba hakika mtaangamia upesi kutoka katika nchi mnayovukia Yordani ili kuimiliki. Hamtazidisha siku [zenu] juu yake, kwa maana hakika mtaangamizwa.
sw.B: Leo naziita mbingu na nchi zishuhudie juu yenu: mtafutiliwa mbali upesi kutoka katika nchi mnayovuka Yordani kwenda kuimiliki. Hamtaishi humo muda mrefu; mtaangamizwa kabisa.
sw.R: Leo ninaita anga na dunia kuwa mashahidi dhidi yenu. Mkifanya hivyo, mtatoweka upesi kutoka katika nchi mnayovuka Mto Yordani kwenda kuimiliki. Hamtaishi huko muda mrefu. Mtaangamizwa kabisa.

decisions.choice: heaven and earth as witnesses: the witnesses of a covenant
decisions.reason: Treaties of the time named witnesses who would see that the terms were kept. Moses calls on heaven and earth, which last from generation to generation (30:19; 31:28; 32:1; Isaiah 1:2).

decisions.choice: perishing you will perish ... being destroyed you will be destroyed: certainty
decisions.reason: Hebrew repeats the verb to make a statement certain and strong. The loss of the land is sure if they turn to idols.

decisions.choice: prolong days: live long
decisions.reason: To "lengthen days" on the land is to live long there and keep it (verse 40; 5:33).

decisions.choice: If you do that
decisions.reason: Readable states the condition carried over from verse 25.

source.text: וְהֵפִ֧יץ יְהוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּעַמִּ֑ים וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר בַּגּוֹיִ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְנַהֵ֧ג יְהוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם שָֽׁמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And will scatter Yahweh you among the peoples, and you will be left men of number among the nations where will drive Yahweh you there.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will drive you.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left a small number among the nations to which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} drives you.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will scatter you among other nations. Only a few of you will be left alive in the places where {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sends you.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los|os}} esparcirá entre los pueblos, y {{plural_you:quedarán|quedaréis}} pocos en número entre las naciones adonde {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los|os}} llevará.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los|os}} dispersará entre los pueblos, y {{plural_you:quedarán|quedaréis}} unos pocos entre las naciones adonde {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los|os}} expulse.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los|os}} dispersará entre otras naciones. Solo unos pocos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} quedarán con vida en los lugares adonde {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los|os}} envíe.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous dispersera parmi les peuples, et vous resterez en petit nombre parmi les nations où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous emmènera.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous disséminera parmi les peuples, et il ne restera de vous qu’un petit nombre parmi les nations où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous chassera.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous dispersera parmi d’autres nations. Seuls quelques-uns d’entre vous resteront en vie dans les pays où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous enverra.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawatawanya kati ya mataifa, nanyi mtasalia wachache kwa hesabu kati ya mataifa ambako {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawapeleka.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawatawanya kati ya mataifa, nanyi mtabaki wachache kati ya mataifa ambako {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawafukuzia.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawatawanya kati ya mataifa mengine. Ni wachache tu kati yenu watakaobaki hai katika nchi ambako {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawapeleka.

decisions.choice: men of number: few, so few they could be counted
decisions.reason: People who can be counted are few (Genesis 34:30; Jeremiah 44:28). The people once as many as the stars (1:10) would be reduced to a remnant.

decisions.choice: scatter: exile as the judgment of the covenant
decisions.reason: Being driven from the land and scattered among nations is one of the covenant curses (28:36, 64), and it came about in the exiles to Assyria and Babylon (2 Kings 17:6; 25:21).

decisions.choice: few in number
decisions.reason: The Hebrew idiom is put in words English can follow even at Literal.

source.text: וַעֲבַדְתֶּם־שָׁ֣ם אֱלֹהִ֔ים מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם עֵ֣ץ וָאֶ֔בֶן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־יִרְאוּן֙ וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמְע֔וּן וְלֹ֥א יֹֽאכְל֖וּן וְלֹ֥א יְרִיחֻֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will serve there gods, [the] work of [the] hands of man, wood and stone, which not see and not hear and not eat and not smell.

en.L: And there you will serve gods, the work of human hands, wood and stone, which do not see and do not hear and do not eat and do not smell.
en.B: There you will serve gods that human hands have made, wood and stone, gods that neither see nor hear, neither eat nor smell.
en.R: There you will worship gods that people have made out of wood and stone. These gods cannot see, hear, eat, or smell.

es.L: Y allí {{plural_you:servirán|serviréis}} a dioses, obra de manos humanas, madera y piedra, que no ven, ni oyen, ni comen, ni huelen.
es.B: Allí {{plural_you:servirán|serviréis}} a dioses hechos por manos humanas, de madera y de piedra, dioses que no ven ni oyen, no comen ni huelen.
es.R: Allí {{plural_you:adorarán|adoraréis}} a dioses que la gente ha hecho de madera y de piedra. Esos dioses no pueden ver, ni oír, ni comer, ni oler.

fr.L: Et là vous servirez des dieux, ouvrage de mains humaines, du bois et de la pierre, qui ne voient pas, et n’entendent pas, et ne mangent pas, et ne sentent pas.
fr.B: Là, vous servirez des dieux faits par des mains humaines, de bois et de pierre, des dieux qui ne voient ni n’entendent, ne mangent ni ne sentent.
fr.R: Là-bas, vous adorerez des dieux que des humains ont fabriqués avec du bois et de la pierre. Ces dieux ne peuvent ni voir, ni entendre, ni manger, ni sentir.

sw.L: Nanyi mtatumikia huko miungu, kazi ya mikono ya binadamu, miti na mawe, isiyoona, wala kusikia, wala kula, wala kunusa.
sw.B: Huko mtatumikia miungu iliyotengenezwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu, ya miti na mawe, miungu isiyoona wala kusikia, isiyokula wala kunusa.
sw.R: Huko mtaabudu miungu ambayo watu wameitengeneza kwa miti na mawe. Miungu hiyo haiwezi kuona, kusikia, kula wala kunusa.

decisions.choice: serving lifeless gods: the punishment matches the sin
decisions.reason: Those who wanted to make images will end up serving images in exile. The idols have none of the senses of living beings, unlike the God who speaks and hears (Psalm 115:4-7; 135:15-17).

decisions.choice: man: human beings
decisions.reason: The word means humankind. The gods are things people have made.

decisions.choice: neither see nor hear / cannot see
decisions.reason: "Do not see" means they are not able to. Balanced says "neither ... nor" and Readable "cannot".

source.text: וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּ֥ם מִשָּׁ֛ם אֶת־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ וּמָצָ֑אתָ כִּ֣י תִדְרְשֶׁ֔נּוּ בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכָל־נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will seek from there Yahweh your God, and you will find, when you search for him with all your heart and with all your soul.

en.L: And from there you will seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and you will find [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}], when you search for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with all your heart and with all your soul.
en.B: But from there you will seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and you will find {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, if you search after {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with all your heart and with all your soul.
en.R: But even there you will look for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. And you will find {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} if you look for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with all your heart and with all your being.

es.L: Y desde allí {{plural_you:buscarán|buscaréis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, y [{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}] hallarás, cuando {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} busques con todo tu corazón y con toda tu alma.
es.B: Pero desde allí {{plural_you:buscarán|buscaréis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} encontrarás, si {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} buscas con todo tu corazón y con toda tu alma.
es.R: Pero aun allí {{plural_you:buscarán|buscaréis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios. Y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} encontrarás si {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} buscas con todo tu corazón y con todo tu ser.

fr.L: Et de là, vous chercherez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, et tu [{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}] trouveras, quand tu {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} rechercheras de tout ton cœur et de toute ton âme.
fr.B: Mais de là-bas, vous chercherez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, et tu {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} trouveras, si tu {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} recherches de tout ton cœur et de toute ton âme.
fr.R: Mais même là-bas, vous chercherez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu. Et tu {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} trouveras si tu {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} cherches de tout ton cœur et de tout ton être.

sw.L: Nanyi mtamtafuta huko {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, nawe utamwona, utakapomtafuta kwa moyo wako wote na kwa nafsi yako yote.
sw.B: Lakini mkiwa huko mtamtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, nawe utamwona, ukimtafuta kwa moyo wako wote na kwa nafsi yako yote.
sw.R: Lakini hata huko mtamtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Nawe utampata ukimtafuta kwa moyo wako wote na kwa utu wako wote.

decisions.choice: when: the condition for finding him
decisions.reason: The word can mean "when" or "if" or "because". God will be found by those who seek him wholeheartedly (Jeremiah 29:13).

decisions.choice: with all your heart and all your soul: with the whole person
decisions.reason: Heart is mind and will; soul is the self, one's very life. Together they mean with everything one is (6:5; 10:12).

decisions.choice: seek, search for: two verbs for seeking God
decisions.reason: The first means to look for; the second, to inquire after, to seek earnestly. The repetition stresses the seeking.

decisions.choice: But
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable mark the turn from exile to hope with "But".

decisions.choice: being
decisions.reason: Readable says "being" for "soul", the whole self, since "soul" can suggest only an inner part of a person. Literal and Balanced keep "soul".

decisions.choice: "kwa moyo wako wote na kwa nafsi yako yote"
decisions.reason: For Deuteronomy's recurring "with all your heart and all your soul" (4:29; 6:5; 10:12; 30:2, 6). The soul (nefesh) is the living self, which "nafsi" says; "roho" is kept for the spirit. Readable says "kwa utu wako wote" (your whole being), as the English Readable says "being".

source.text: בַּצַּ֣ר לְךָ֔ וּמְצָא֕וּךָ כֹּ֖ל הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה בְּאַחֲרִית֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וְשַׁבְתָּ֙ עַד־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֖ בְּקֹלֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: In your distress, and find you all the things these in [the] latter end of the days, and you will return to Yahweh your God and listen to his voice.

en.L: In your distress, when all these things have found you in the latter end of the days, you will return to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and listen to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice.
en.B: In your distress, when all these things have overtaken you in the days to come, you will turn back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and obey {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Someday you will be in deep trouble, and all these things will happen to you. Then you will come back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and obey {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: En tu angustia, cuando te hayan alcanzado todas estas cosas al final de los días, volverás {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios y escucharás {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz.
es.B: En tu angustia, cuando te hayan sobrevenido todas estas cosas en los días venideros, te volverás {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} obedecerás.
es.R: Algún día estarás en grandes problemas, y te pasarán todas estas cosas. Entonces volverás {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} obedecerás.

fr.L: Dans ta détresse, quand toutes ces choses t’auront trouvé dans la suite des jours, tu reviendras {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu et tu écouteras {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix.
fr.B: Dans ta détresse, quand toutes ces choses t’auront atteint dans les jours à venir, tu reviendras {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu et tu {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéiras.
fr.R: Un jour, tu seras dans un grand malheur, et toutes ces choses t’arriveront. Alors tu reviendras {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu et tu {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéiras.

sw.L: Katika dhiki yako, mambo haya yote yatakapokupata katika siku za baadaye, utarudi kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako na kuisikiliza sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Katika dhiki yako, mambo haya yote yatakapokupata katika siku zijazo, utarudi kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako na kumtii.
sw.R: Siku moja utakuwa katika taabu kubwa, na mambo haya yote yatakupata. Ndipo utarudi kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako na kumtii.

decisions.choice: the latter end of the days: the time to come, the future
decisions.reason: The phrase points ahead to a later time (31:29; Genesis 49:1). Here it is the time after the exile has come; it need not mean the end of the world.

decisions.choice: return: turn back to God, repent
decisions.reason: The verb means to turn around. Turning back to God after going after other gods is repentance (30:2, 8-10).

decisions.choice: listen to his voice: obey him
decisions.reason: To listen to someone's voice in Hebrew is to do what they say.

decisions.choice: obey him
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom; Literal keeps "listen to his voice".

source.text: כִּ֣י אֵ֤ל רַחוּם֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א יַשְׁחִיתֶ֑ךָ וְלֹ֤א יִשְׁכַּח֙ אֶת־בְּרִ֣ית אֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לָהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For a God compassionate [is] Yahweh your God; not he will let you go, and not destroy you, and not forget the covenant of your fathers that he swore to them.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God [is] a compassionate God; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not let you go, nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} swore to them.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is a God of compassion. He will not let you go or bring you to ruin, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not forget the covenant {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} swore to your ancestors.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God is a God who shows mercy. He will not leave you on your own or destroy you. He will not forget the covenant {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised your ancestors with an oath.

es.L: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios [es] un Dios compasivo; no te soltará, ni te destruirá, ni olvidará el pacto de tus padres que les juró.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios es un Dios compasivo. No te abandonará ni te llevará a la ruina, y no olvidará el pacto que juró a tus antepasados.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios es un Dios que muestra misericordia. No te dejará solo ni te destruirá. No olvidará el pacto que prometió con juramento a tus antepasados.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu [est] un Dieu compatissant ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne te lâchera pas, et ne te détruira pas, et n’oubliera pas l’alliance de tes pères, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur a jurée.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu est un Dieu plein de compassion. Il ne te laissera pas tomber et ne te mènera pas à la ruine, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’oubliera pas l’alliance qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a jurée à tes ancêtres.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu est un Dieu de miséricorde. Il ne t’abandonnera pas et ne te détruira pas. Il n’oubliera pas l’alliance qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a promise par serment à tes ancêtres.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako [ni] Mungu mwenye huruma; hatakuacha, wala hatakuangamiza, wala hatalisahau agano la baba zako alilowaapia.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako ni Mungu wa huruma. Hatakuacha wala kukuangamiza, wala hatalisahau agano alilowaapia mababu zako.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako ni Mungu anayeonyesha rehema. Hatakuacha peke yako wala kukuangamiza. Hatalisahau agano aliloahidi kwa kiapo kwa mababu zako.

decisions.choice: compassionate: tender, full of mercy
decisions.reason: The word is related to the word for womb, and speaks of the tender love of a mother for her child. God names himself so in Exodus 34:6.

decisions.choice: let you go: drop you, leave you without help
decisions.reason: The verb means to let go one's hold or let sink. God will not let go of his people even in exile (31:6, 8).

decisions.choice: the covenant he swore to the fathers: the promises to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
decisions.reason: God bound himself by oath to give Abraham's descendants the land and to be their God (Genesis 15:18; 17:7-8; 22:16-18; 26:3). His faithfulness to that oath is the ground of hope for exiles.

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: As in verse 1.

source.text: כִּ֣י שְׁאַל־נָא֩ לְיָמִ֨ים רִֽאשֹׁנִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־הָי֣וּ לְפָנֶ֗יךָ לְמִן־הַיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁר֩ בָּרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀אָדָם֙ עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ וּלְמִקְצֵ֥ה הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְעַד־קְצֵ֣ה הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם הֲנִֽהְיָ֗ה כַּדָּבָ֤ר הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַזֶּ֔ה א֖וֹ הֲנִשְׁמַ֥ע כָּמֹֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For ask, please, about [the] days former that were before you, from the day that created God man on the earth, and from [the] end of the heavens and to [the] end of the heavens: has there been [anything] like the thing great this, or has been heard [anything] like it?

en.L: For ask now about the former days that were before you, from the day that God created humankind on the earth, and from [one] end of the heavens to [the other] end of the heavens: has [anything] been like this great thing, or has [anything] like it been heard?
en.B: Go ahead and inquire about the past, the days that came before you, back to the day God created human beings on the earth. Search from one edge of the sky to the other. Has anything this great ever taken place? Has anything like it ever been heard?
en.R: Think about the past, long before you were born. Go all the way back to the day God made people on the earth. Search the whole world, from one end of the sky to the other. Has anything this great ever happened before? Has anyone ever heard of anything like it?

es.L: Porque pregunta ahora acerca de los días pasados que fueron antes de ti, desde el día en que Dios creó al ser humano sobre la tierra, y desde [un] extremo de los cielos hasta [el otro] extremo de los cielos: ¿ha habido [algo] como esta gran cosa, o se ha oído [algo] como ella?
es.B: Anda, infórmate sobre el pasado, sobre los días que te precedieron, desde el día en que Dios creó a los seres humanos sobre la tierra. Busca de un extremo al otro del cielo. ¿Ha sucedido alguna vez algo tan grande? ¿Se ha oído jamás algo parecido?
es.R: Piensa en el pasado, mucho antes de que nacieras. Vuelve hasta el día en que Dios hizo a la gente sobre la tierra. Busca por todo el mundo, de un extremo al otro del cielo. ¿Ha pasado antes algo tan grande? ¿Alguien ha oído alguna vez algo así?

fr.L: Car interroge donc les jours d’autrefois qui ont été avant toi, depuis le jour où Dieu a créé l’être humain sur la terre, et d’[une] extrémité des cieux jusqu’à [l’autre] extrémité des cieux : y a-t-il eu [rien de] semblable à cette grande chose, ou a-t-on entendu [rien de] pareil ?
fr.B: Renseigne-toi donc sur le passé, sur les jours qui t’ont précédé, depuis le jour où Dieu a créé les humains sur la terre. Cherche d’un bout du ciel à l’autre. Est-il jamais arrivé quelque chose d’aussi grand ? A-t-on jamais entendu rien de semblable ?
fr.R: Pense au passé, bien avant ta naissance. Remonte jusqu’au jour où Dieu a créé les humains sur la terre. Cherche dans le monde entier, d’un bout du ciel à l’autre. Est-ce qu’une chose aussi grande est déjà arrivée ? Est-ce que quelqu’un a déjà entendu parler d’une chose pareille ?

sw.L: Kwa maana uliza sasa habari za siku za zamani zilizokuwa kabla yako, tangu siku ile Mungu alipomuumba mwanadamu juu ya nchi, na tangu mwisho [mmoja] wa mbingu hadi mwisho [mwingine] wa mbingu: je, [kumekuwa na jambo] kama jambo hili kubwa, au [jambo] kama hili limesikiwa?
sw.B: Haya, uliza habari za zamani, za siku zilizotangulia kabla yako, tangu siku Mungu alipowaumba wanadamu duniani. Chunguza tangu upande mmoja wa anga hadi mwingine. Je, kumewahi kutokea jambo kubwa kama hili? Je, limewahi kusikika jambo kama hili?
sw.R: Fikiria mambo ya zamani, kabla hujazaliwa. Rudi nyuma hadi siku ile Mungu alipowaumba watu duniani. Tafuta ulimwenguni kote, tangu upande mmoja wa anga hadi mwingine. Je, jambo kubwa kama hili limewahi kutokea? Je, mtu yeyote amewahi kusikia habari ya jambo kama hili?

decisions.choice: the day God created humankind: the creation of Genesis 1
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in Genesis 1:1, 27 for God's creating. Moses invites a search through all of history since then.

decisions.choice: from one end of the heavens to the other: everywhere under the sky
decisions.reason: The sky was pictured as a vault with edges at the horizon. From end to end means the whole world (30:4).

decisions.choice: has there been ...? : questions that expect "never"
decisions.reason: Like verses 7-8, the questions make a point: nothing like this has ever happened or been heard of.

decisions.choice: Think about ... Search the whole world
decisions.reason: "Ask" here means to look into the past and the whole world for anything comparable. Readable says that directly.

source.text: הֲשָׁ֣מַֽע עָם֩ ק֨וֹל אֱלֹהִ֜ים מְדַבֵּ֧ר מִתּוֹךְ־הָאֵ֛שׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר־שָׁמַ֥עְתָּ אַתָּ֖ה וַיֶּֽחִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Has heard a people [the] voice of God speaking from [the] midst of the fire, as have heard you, and lived?

en.L: Has a people heard the voice of God speaking from the midst of the fire, as you yourself have heard, and lived?
en.B: Did any people ever hear the voice of God speaking from the midst of fire, as you heard it, and live?
en.R: Has any other nation ever heard God speaking from the middle of a fire, as you did, and still lived?

es.L: ¿Ha oído un pueblo la voz de Dios hablando de en medio del fuego, como la has oído tú, y ha vivido?
es.B: ¿Hubo jamás algún pueblo que oyera la voz de Dios hablando desde el fuego, como tú la oíste, y siguiera con vida?
es.R: ¿Alguna otra nación ha oído a Dios hablar desde el medio de un fuego, como tú lo oíste, y ha seguido con vida?

fr.L: Un peuple a-t-il entendu la voix de Dieu parlant du milieu du feu, comme toi tu [l’]as entendue, et est-il resté en vie ?
fr.B: Un peuple a-t-il jamais entendu la voix de Dieu parler du milieu du feu, comme tu l’as entendue, et est-il resté vivant ?
fr.R: Est-ce qu’une autre nation a déjà entendu Dieu parler du milieu d’un feu, comme toi, et est restée en vie ?

sw.L: Je, watu wameisikia sauti ya Mungu akisema kutoka katikati ya moto, kama wewe ulivyosikia, nao wakaishi?
sw.B: Je, kuna watu waliowahi kusikia sauti ya Mungu akisema kutoka katikati ya moto, kama ulivyosikia wewe, nao wakabaki hai?
sw.R: Je, kuna taifa jingine lolote lililowahi kumsikia Mungu akisema kutoka katikati ya moto, kama ulivyosikia wewe, likabaki hai?

decisions.choice: God: Israel's God, or any god
decisions.reason: The word can mean God or a god. Here it most likely means God himself, who spoke at Horeb (5:26 "the living God"); the question asks whether any other people has had this experience.

decisions.choice: and lived: hearing God directly was thought to bring death
decisions.reason: The people at Horeb feared they would die if they heard God's voice again (5:24-26; Exodus 20:19). That they lived is part of the wonder.

decisions.choice: any other
decisions.reason: Readable adds "other" to make clear that Israel is the one people that has. Literal and Balanced keep the open question.

source.text: א֣וֹ׀הֲנִסָּ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֗ים לָ֠בוֹא לָקַ֨חַת ל֣וֹ גוֹי֮ מִקֶּ֣רֶב גּוֹי֒ בְּמַסֹּת֩ בְּאֹתֹ֨ת וּבְמוֹפְתִ֜ים וּבְמִלְחָמָ֗ה וּבְיָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבְמוֹרָאִ֖ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם לְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Or has tried a god to go to take for himself a nation from [the] midst of a nation, by trials, by signs and by wonders, and by war, and by a hand strong and by an arm outstretched, and by terrors great, like all that did for you Yahweh your God in Egypt before your eyes?

en.L: Or has a god tried to go and take for himself a nation from the midst of [another] nation, by trials, by signs and by wonders, and by war, and by a strong hand and by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, like all that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
en.B: Or did any god ever attempt to come and take one nation for himself from within another, by trials, signs and wonders, by war, by a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God did for you in Egypt while you watched?
en.R: Has any other god ever tried to take one nation out from inside another nation and make it his own? {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God did that for you in Egypt, and you saw it happen. He sent trials and signs and miracles. He fought a war. He used {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great power and strength and did terrifying things.

es.L: ¿O ha intentado algún dios ir a tomar para sí una nación de en medio de [otra] nación, con pruebas, con señales y con prodigios, y con guerra, y con mano fuerte y con brazo extendido, y con grandes terrores, como todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} hizo por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en Egipto ante tus ojos?
es.B: ¿O acaso algún dios intentó jamás venir a tomar para sí una nación de en medio de otra, con pruebas, señales y prodigios, con guerra, con mano fuerte y brazo extendido, y con grandes terrores, como lo hizo por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} en Egipto, ante tus propios ojos?
es.R: ¿Algún otro dios ha intentado alguna vez sacar a una nación de en medio de otra nación para hacerla suya? {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} hizo eso por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en Egipto, y tú lo viste suceder. Envió pruebas, señales y milagros. Hizo la guerra. Usó {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran poder y fuerza, e hizo cosas que causaban terror.

fr.L: Ou un dieu a-t-il tenté d’aller prendre pour lui une nation du milieu d’une [autre] nation, par des épreuves, par des signes et par des prodiges, et par la guerre, et par une main forte et par un bras étendu, et par de grandes terreurs, comme tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu a fait pour vous en Égypte sous tes yeux ?
fr.B: Ou bien un dieu a-t-il jamais essayé de venir prendre pour lui une nation au sein d’une autre, par des épreuves, des signes et des prodiges, par la guerre, d’une main forte et d’un bras étendu, et par de grandes terreurs, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu l’a fait pour vous en Égypte, sous tes yeux ?
fr.R: Est-ce qu’un autre dieu a déjà essayé de prendre une nation du milieu d’une autre nation pour qu’elle soit à lui ? {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu l’a fait pour vous en Égypte, et tu l’as vu de tes yeux. Il a envoyé des épreuves, des signes et des miracles. Il a fait la guerre. Il a montré {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grande puissance et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} force, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait des choses terrifiantes.

sw.L: Au je, mungu amejaribu kwenda kujitwalia taifa kutoka katikati ya taifa [jingine], kwa majaribu, kwa ishara na kwa maajabu, na kwa vita, na kwa mkono wenye nguvu na kwa mkono ulionyooshwa, na kwa vitisho vikuu, kama yote ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu aliwafanyia huko Misri mbele ya macho yako?
sw.B: Au je, mungu yeyote amewahi kujaribu kuja kujitwalia taifa moja kutoka ndani ya taifa jingine, kwa majaribu, ishara na maajabu, kwa vita, kwa mkono wenye nguvu na mkono ulionyooshwa, na kwa matendo makuu ya kutisha, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu alivyowafanyia huko Misri, ukiona kwa macho yako?
sw.R: Je, kuna mungu mwingine yeyote aliyewahi kujaribu kulitoa taifa moja ndani ya taifa jingine na kulifanya lake? {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu aliwafanyia hivyo huko Misri, nawe uliona yakitendeka. Alileta majaribu, ishara na miujiza. Alipigana vita. Alitumia uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mkuu na nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, akafanya mambo ya kutisha.

decisions.choice: a god: any so-called god of the nations
decisions.reason: Here the word means "a god", since its verb and "for himself" are singular and the question compares the LORD with others: has any god ever done such a thing?

decisions.choice: trials: tests, the plagues that put Pharaoh to the test
decisions.reason: The word means testings. The plagues tested Pharaoh and Egypt again and again (7:19; 29:2 in Hebrew numbering).

decisions.choice: a strong hand and an outstretched arm: God's power in action
decisions.reason: The hand and arm are pictures of strength put to work. The phrase recalls the exodus (5:15; 26:8; Exodus 6:6).

decisions.choice: terrors: awe-inspiring deeds that cause fear
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb "fear". It names deeds so great that those who see them are struck with awe (26:8; 34:12).

decisions.choice: Has any other god ...? The LORD your God did that for you ...
decisions.reason: Readable asks the question first and then lists what God did in separate short sentences.

decisions.choice: signs and miracles
decisions.reason: "Wonders" in Readable is "miracles", acts beyond what is natural.

source.text: אַתָּה֙ הָרְאֵ֣תָ לָדַ֔עַת כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה ה֣וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ין ע֖וֹד מִלְבַדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: You, you were shown to know that Yahweh, he [is] the God; there is no other besides him.

en.L: You were shown [this] so that you would know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] the God; there is no other besides {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: You were shown all this so that you would know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is God, and that there is no other besides {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} showed you these things so that you would know that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is the true God. There is no other God but {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: A ti se te hizo ver [esto] para que supieras que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] el Dios; no hay otro fuera de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: A ti se te mostró todo esto para que supieras que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es Dios, y que no hay otro fuera de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te mostró estas cosas para que supieras que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es el Dios verdadero. No hay otro Dios fuera de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: Toi, on te [l’]a fait voir pour que tu saches que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} [qui est] le Dieu ; il n’y en a pas d’autre en dehors de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Tout cela, on te l’a fait voir pour que tu saches que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est Dieu, et qu’il n’y en a pas d’autre en dehors de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a montré ces choses pour que tu saches que c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} le vrai Dieu. Il n’y a pas d’autre Dieu que {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Wewe ulionyeshwa [haya] ili ujue kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ndiye] Mungu; hakuna mwingine ila {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.
sw.B: Wewe ulionyeshwa haya yote ili ujue kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye Mungu, na hakuna mwingine ila {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuonyesha mambo haya ili ujue kwamba {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye Mungu wa kweli. Hakuna Mungu mwingine ila {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.

decisions.choice: you were shown: God made you see
decisions.reason: The verb is passive: Israel was made to see. God is the one who showed them these things, and the purpose was knowledge.

decisions.choice: the God: God in the full sense, the only true God
decisions.reason: With the article, the word means "the God", the one who truly is God (verse 39; 1 Kings 18:39).

decisions.choice: there is no other besides him: the LORD alone is God
decisions.reason: The verse denies that any other god is truly God (verse 39; 32:39; Isaiah 45:5-6).

decisions.choice: The LORD showed you ... the true God
decisions.reason: Readable names the LORD as the one who showed them, and says "true" for the force of "the God".

source.text: מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם הִשְׁמִֽיעֲךָ֥ אֶת־קֹל֖וֹ לְיַסְּרֶ֑ךָּ וְעַל־הָאָ֗רֶץ הֶרְאֲךָ֙ אֶת־אִשּׁ֣וֹ הַגְּדוֹלָ֔ה וּדְבָרָ֥יו שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: From the heavens he made you hear his voice to discipline you, and on the earth he showed you his fire great, and his words you heard from [the] midst of the fire.

en.L: From the heavens {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made you hear {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice to discipline you, and on the earth {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} showed you {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great fire, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} words you heard from the midst of the fire.
en.B: He let you hear {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice from heaven to instruct you, and on earth {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} let you see {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great fire; out of that fire you heard {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} words.
en.R: He spoke to you from heaven so that you would learn from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. On earth {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} showed you {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great fire, and you heard {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} speak from the fire.

es.L: Desde los cielos te hizo oír {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz para disciplinarte, y sobre la tierra te mostró {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran fuego, y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} palabras oíste de en medio del fuego.
es.B: Desde el cielo te dejó oír {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz para instruirte, y en la tierra te dejó ver {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran fuego; de en medio de aquel fuego oíste {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} palabras.
es.R: Te habló desde el cielo para que aprendieras de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. En la tierra te mostró {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran fuego, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} oíste hablar desde el fuego.

fr.L: Des cieux {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a fait entendre {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix pour t’éduquer, et sur la terre {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a fait voir {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} grand feu, et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} paroles, tu les as entendues du milieu du feu.
fr.B: Il t’a fait entendre {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix depuis le ciel pour t’instruire, et sur la terre {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a fait voir {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} grand feu ; et du milieu de ce feu tu as entendu {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} paroles.
fr.R: Il t’a parlé depuis le ciel pour que tu apprennes de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Sur la terre, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a montré {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} grand feu, et tu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}as entendu parler du milieu du feu.

sw.L: Kutoka mbinguni alikusikilizisha sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ili akuadibu, na juu ya nchi alikuonyesha moto {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mkuu, na maneno {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} uliyasikia kutoka katikati ya moto.
sw.B: Alikuacha usikie sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kutoka mbinguni ili akufundishe, na duniani alikuacha uone moto {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mkuu; nawe ulisikia maneno {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kutoka katika moto huo.
sw.R: Alisema nawe kutoka mbinguni ili ujifunze kutoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. Duniani alikuonyesha moto {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mkuu, nawe ulimsikia akisema kutoka katika moto huo.

decisions.choice: discipline: train and correct, like a father
decisions.reason: The verb means to instruct by correction, as a parent trains a child (8:5). God's voice from heaven taught Israel who he is and how to live.

decisions.choice: from heaven ... on earth: God above all, yet present to speak
decisions.reason: God's voice came from heaven and his fire was seen on the mountain. He is not bound to any place on earth, and yet he came near (verse 39; Exodus 20:22).

decisions.choice: instruct / learn from him
decisions.reason: Balanced says "instruct" and Readable "learn from him", since "discipline" can suggest only punishment.

source.text: וְתַ֗חַת כִּ֤י אָהַב֙ אֶת־אֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ וַיִּבְחַ֥ר בְּזַרְע֖וֹ אַחֲרָ֑יו וַיּוֹצִֽאֲךָ֧ בְּפָנָ֛יו בְּכֹח֥וֹ הַגָּדֹ֖ל מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And because he loved your fathers and chose his offspring after him, and he brought you out by his presence, by his power great, from Egypt,

en.L: And because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} loved your fathers and chose his offspring after him, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brought you out with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence, with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great power, from Egypt,
en.B: He loved your ancestors and chose their descendants after them, and for that reason {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} brought you out of Egypt with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great power,
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} loved your ancestors and chose their descendants. That is why {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} went with you and brought you out of Egypt by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great power.

es.L: Y porque amó a tus padres y escogió a su descendencia después de él, te sacó con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia, con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran poder, de Egipto,
es.B: Amó a tus antepasados y escogió a sus descendientes después de ellos, y por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo te sacó de Egipto con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran poder,
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} amó a tus antepasados y escogió a sus descendientes. Por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo fue contigo y te sacó de Egipto con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran poder.

fr.L: Et parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a aimé tes pères et a choisi sa descendance après lui, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a fait sortir par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence, par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grande puissance, de l’Égypte,
fr.B: Il a aimé tes ancêtres et choisi leurs descendants après eux, et c’est pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} fait sortir d’Égypte par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grande puissance,
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a aimé tes ancêtres, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisi leurs descendants. C’est pour cela qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est venu {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} avec toi et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a fait sortir d’Égypte par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grande puissance.

sw.L: Na kwa sababu aliwapenda baba zako na kuuchagua uzao wake baada yake, alikutoa kwa uwepo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kuu, kutoka Misri,
sw.B: Aliwapenda mababu zako na kuwachagua wazao wao baada yao, na kwa sababu hiyo {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} alikutoa Misri kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kuu,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapenda mababu zako na kuwachagua wazao wao. Ndiyo sababu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} alikwenda pamoja nawe akakutoa Misri kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kuu.

decisions.choice: his offspring after him: the descendants of the fathers
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "his" and "him", singular, though "fathers" is plural; the singular may think of Abraham, or of the fathers as one. The Samaritan Pentateuch and the ancient Greek and Syriac versions have "their offspring after them". Either way the meaning is the descendants of the fathers, that is, Israel (10:15).

decisions.choice: by his presence: in person
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is "by his face". God did not send someone else; he himself went with Israel (Exodus 33:14-15; Isaiah 63:9).

decisions.choice: because he loved and chose: God's choice rests on his love
decisions.reason: Israel was not chosen for its size or merit but because God loved its fathers (7:7-8; 10:15).

decisions.choice: their descendants after them
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "their" so that the words are not taken to mean God's offspring. Literal keeps the singular.

decisions.choice: for that reason he himself / That is why he himself went with you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put "because" as a clause of reason after the fact and explain "by his presence" as God himself; Readable also names the LORD.

source.text: לְהוֹרִ֗ישׁ גּוֹיִ֛ם גְּדֹלִ֧ים וַעֲצֻמִ֛ים מִמְּךָ֖ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ לַהֲבִֽיאֲךָ֗ לָֽתֶת־לְךָ֧ אֶת־אַרְצָ֛ם נַחֲלָ֖ה כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: to dispossess nations greater and mightier than you from before you, to bring you in, to give to you their land [as] an inheritance, as [this] day this.

en.L: to dispossess nations greater and mightier than you from before you, to bring you in, to give you their land [as] an inheritance, as [it is] this day.
en.B: driving out ahead of you nations bigger and mightier than you, to bring you in and give you their land as your inheritance, as it now is.
en.R: He did this in order to drive out nations that were bigger and stronger than you. He brought you in to give you their land to keep as your own, as is happening today.

es.L: para desposeer delante de ti a naciones más grandes y más fuertes que tú, para introducirte, para darte su tierra [como] heredad, como [es] este día.
es.B: expulsando delante de ti a naciones más grandes y poderosas que tú, para hacerte entrar y darte su tierra como heredad, como sucede hoy.
es.R: Lo hizo para expulsar a naciones más grandes y fuertes que tú. Te hizo entrar para darte la tierra de ellas, para que fuera tuya, como está sucediendo hoy.

fr.L: pour déposséder devant toi des nations plus grandes et plus puissantes que toi, pour te faire entrer, pour te donner leur pays [en] héritage, comme [c’est le cas] en ce jour.
fr.B: en chassant devant toi des nations plus grandes et plus puissantes que toi, pour te faire entrer et te donner leur pays en héritage, comme c’est le cas aujourd’hui.
fr.R: Il l’a fait pour chasser des nations plus grandes et plus fortes que toi. Il t’a fait entrer pour te donner leur pays, pour qu’il soit à toi, comme cela se passe aujourd’hui.

sw.L: ili kufukuza mbele yako mataifa makubwa na yenye nguvu kuliko wewe, ili kukuingiza, ili kukupa nchi yao [iwe] urithi, kama [ilivyo] siku hii.
sw.B: akifukuza mbele yako mataifa makubwa na yenye nguvu kuliko wewe, ili akuingize na kukupa nchi yao iwe urithi wako, kama ilivyo sasa.
sw.R: Alifanya hivyo ili kufukuza mataifa yaliyokuwa makubwa na yenye nguvu kuliko wewe. Alikuingiza ili akupe nchi yao iwe yako, kama inavyotokea leo.

decisions.choice: dispossess: drive out the nations and take their place
decisions.reason: The verb used for taking possession of the land, in this form, means to make others lose possession: to drive them out (7:1; 9:1-5).

decisions.choice: as it is this day: already begun east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Israel already holds the lands of Sihon and Og (2:24-3:17; verses 46-47), a first share of the gift.

decisions.choice: He did this in order to
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence and names the purpose, since its verse 37 ended with a full stop.

source.text: וְיָדַעְתָּ֣ הַיּ֗וֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ֮ אֶל־לְבָבֶךָ֒ כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם מִמַּ֔עַל וְעַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ מִתָּ֑חַת אֵ֖ין עֽוֹד׃

records.literal_gloss: And you shall know today and bring back to your heart that Yahweh, he [is] the God in the heavens above and on the earth beneath; there is no other.

en.L: And you shall know today, and bring [it] back to your heart, that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] the God in the heavens above and on the earth beneath; there is no other.
en.B: So know this today, and take it to heart: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is God in the heavens above and on the earth below, and there is no other.
en.R: So today, understand this and never forget it: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is God in heaven above and on the earth below. There is no other God.

es.L: Y sabrás hoy, y [lo] harás volver a tu corazón, que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] el Dios en los cielos arriba y sobre la tierra abajo; no hay otro.
es.B: Reconoce, pues, hoy y grábalo en tu corazón: {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es Dios arriba en los cielos y abajo en la tierra, y no hay otro.
es.R: Así que hoy entiende esto y nunca lo olvides: {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es Dios arriba en el cielo y abajo en la tierra. No hay otro Dios.

fr.L: Et tu sauras aujourd’hui, et tu ramèneras [cela] à ton cœur, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} [qui est] le Dieu dans les cieux en haut et sur la terre en bas ; il n’y en a pas d’autre.
fr.B: Sache-le donc aujourd’hui et prends-le à cœur : {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est Dieu en haut dans les cieux et en bas sur la terre, et il n’y en a pas d’autre.
fr.R: Alors aujourd’hui, comprends bien ceci et ne l’oublie jamais : {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est Dieu en haut dans le ciel et en bas sur la terre. Il n’y a pas d’autre Dieu.

sw.L: Nawe utajua leo, na kuyarudisha moyoni mwako, kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ndiye] Mungu katika mbingu juu na juu ya nchi chini; hakuna mwingine.
sw.B: Basi ujue leo, na uweke moyoni: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye Mungu mbinguni juu na duniani chini, wala hakuna mwingine.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo leo elewa jambo hili na usilisahau kamwe: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye Mungu mbinguni juu na duniani chini. Hakuna Mungu mwingine.

decisions.choice: bring back to your heart: take to heart, keep in mind
decisions.reason: To bring something back to the heart is to think it over and let it shape one's thinking (30:1; 1 Kings 8:47).

decisions.choice: God in heaven and on earth; there is no other
decisions.reason: As in verse 35. The God who spoke from heaven and showed his fire on earth (verse 36) rules in both; no other god has any place.

decisions.choice: There is no other God
decisions.reason: Readable says what "no other" means.

source.text: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֞ אֶת־חֻקָּ֣יו וְאֶת־מִצְוֺתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֤י מְצַוְּךָ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר֙ יִיטַ֣ב לְךָ֔ וּלְבָנֶ֖יךָ אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ וּלְמַ֨עַן תַּאֲרִ֤יךְ יָמִים֙ עַל־הַ֣אֲדָמָ֔האֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ כָּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And you shall keep his statutes and his commandments that I [am] commanding you today, that it may go well for you and for your children after you, and so that you may prolong days on the land that Yahweh your God [is] giving to you all the days.

en.L: And you shall keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments that I [am] commanding you today, so that it may go well with you and with your {{gender:children|sons}} after you, and so that you may prolong [your] days on the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God [is] giving you for all time."
en.B: Keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments that I command you today, and things will go well for you and for your {{gender:children|sons}} after you, and you will have long life in the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you for all time."
en.R: Obey {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} laws and commands that I am giving you today. Then things will go well for you and for your {{gender:children|sons}} after you. And you will live a long time in the land {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you to keep forever."

es.L: Y guardarás {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos que yo te mando hoy, para que te vaya bien a ti y a tus hijos después de ti, y para que prolongues [tus] días sobre la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da para siempre».
es.B: Guarda {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos que hoy te mando, y te irá bien a ti y a tus hijos después de ti, y tendrás larga vida en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da para siempre».
es.R: Obedece {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} leyes y mandamientos que hoy te doy. Así te irá bien a ti y a tus hijos después de ti. Y vivirás mucho tiempo en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da para que sea tuya para siempre».

fr.L: Et tu garderas {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements que je te commande aujourd’hui, afin que tout aille bien pour toi et pour tes {{gender:enfants|fils}} après toi, et afin que tu prolonges [tes] jours sur le sol que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne pour toujours. »
fr.B: Garde {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements que je te donne aujourd’hui, et tout ira bien pour toi et pour tes {{gender:enfants|fils}} après toi, et tu vivras longtemps dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne pour toujours. »
fr.R: Obéis à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lois et à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements, que je te donne aujourd’hui. Alors tout ira bien pour toi et pour tes {{gender:enfants|fils}} après toi. Et tu vivras longtemps dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne pour qu’il soit à toi pour toujours. »

sw.L: Nawe utazishika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} ninazokuamuru leo, ili upate mema, wewe na watoto wako baada yako, na ili uzidishe siku [zako] juu ya ardhi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa kwa siku zote."
sw.B: Shika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} ninazokuamuru leo, nawe utafanikiwa, wewe na watoto wako baada yako, na utaishi maisha marefu katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa milele."
sw.R: Zitii sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} ninazokupa leo. Ndipo mambo yatakuendea vema, wewe na watoto wako baada yako. Nawe utaishi muda mrefu katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa iwe yako milele."

decisions.choice: all the days: the land given for all time, or a long life there for always
alternatives: so that you may live long on the land ... for all time
decisions.reason: "All the days" may go with "giving": the land is given for good. Or it may go with "prolong days": Israel may live there always. The Hebrew order puts it after "giving to you", and that is the reading followed here.

decisions.choice: that it may go well with you: that you may prosper
decisions.reason: A common promise in Deuteronomy (5:16, 29; 6:3, 18): obedience brings a good life in the land for the people and their children.

decisions.choice: the end of Moses' first speech
decisions.reason: The speech that began at 1:6 ends here. Verses 41-49 are the narrator's words.

decisions.choice: the closing quotation mark
decisions.reason: The quotation mark opened at 1:6 closes at the end of this verse, where Moses' first speech ends.

source.text: אָ֣ז יַבְדִּ֤יל מֹשֶׁה֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ עָרִ֔ים בְּעֵ֖בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן מִזְרְחָ֖ה שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: Then set apart Moses three cities across the Jordan toward [the] rising of [the] sun,

en.L: Then Moses set apart three cities across the Jordan, toward the rising of the sun,
en.B: Then Moses set apart three cities across the Jordan, to the east,
en.R: Then Moses chose three towns on the east side of the Jordan River.

es.L: Entonces Moisés apartó tres ciudades al otro lado del Jordán, hacia la salida del sol,
es.B: Entonces Moisés apartó tres ciudades al otro lado del Jordán, al oriente,
es.R: Entonces Moisés escogió tres pueblos al lado este del río Jordán.

fr.L: Alors Moïse mit à part trois villes au-delà du Jourdain, vers le lever du soleil,
fr.B: Alors Moïse réserva trois villes au-delà du Jourdain, à l’est,
fr.R: Ensuite, Moïse a choisi trois villes à l’est du Jourdain.

sw.L: Ndipo Musa akatenga miji mitatu ng'ambo ya Yordani, upande wa mawio ya jua,
sw.B: Kisha Musa alitenga miji mitatu ng'ambo ya Yordani, upande wa mashariki,
sw.R: Kisha Musa alichagua miji mitatu upande wa mashariki wa Mto Yordani.

decisions.choice: Then: the narrator speaks again, after Moses' speech
decisions.reason: Moses' first speech ends at verse 40. "Then" loosely ties the next event to that time, in the plains of Moab.

decisions.choice: across the Jordan toward the sunrise: east of the river
decisions.reason: "Across the Jordan" is said from the viewpoint of the land west of it, as at 1:1 and 1:5; "toward the rising of the sun" makes plain that the east side is meant here.

decisions.choice: three cities set apart: the cities of refuge east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: God commanded six cities of refuge, three on each side of the Jordan (Numbers 35:9-15). Moses names the eastern three here; the western three are set apart later (19:1-10; Joshua 20:7-8).

decisions.choice: towns on the east side of the Jordan River
decisions.reason: Readable says "towns", as it does for the cities of refuge, and puts the direction in plain words. It ends the sentence here and goes on in verse 42.

decisions.choice: passé simple at Literal and Balanced ("mit à part", "réserva"), passé composé at Readable ("a choisi") for 4:41-49
alternatives: passé composé at every level, as in Moses' speech
decisions.reason: Moses' speech, told in the passé composé at every level, ends at verse 40. Verses 41-49 are the narrator's words again, so they take the narrative tenses set for Deuteronomy at 1:1: passé simple at Literal and Balanced, passé composé at Readable.

source.text: לָנֻ֨ס שָׁ֜מָּה רוֹצֵ֗חַ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְצַ֤ח אֶת־רֵעֵ֨הוּ֙ בִּבְלִי־דַ֔עַת וְה֛וּא לֹא־שֹׂנֵ֥א ל֖וֹ מִתְּמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשׁ֑וֹם וְנָ֗ס אֶל־אַחַ֛ת מִן־הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖ל וָחָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: for fleeing there of a killer who kills his neighbor without knowledge, and he [was] not hating him from yesterday [and the] third day, and he will flee to one of the cities these and live:

en.L: for a killer to flee there, who kills his neighbor without knowing, and he [was] not hating him in time past; and he may flee to one of these cities and live:
en.B: so that anyone who had killed a neighbor by accident, without having been an enemy beforehand, could flee there. By fleeing to one of these cities, that person could stay alive.
en.R: If someone killed another person by accident, and had not hated that person before, the killer could run to one of these towns and stay alive.

es.L: para que huyera allí el homicida que matara a su prójimo sin saber[lo], no habiéndolo odiado en tiempo pasado; y que huyera a una de estas ciudades y viviera:
es.B: para que cualquiera que hubiera matado a su prójimo por accidente, sin haber sido antes su enemigo, pudiera huir allí. Huyendo a una de estas ciudades, esa persona podría salvar la vida.
es.R: Si alguien mataba a otra persona por accidente, y antes no la odiaba, podía huir a uno de estos pueblos y salvar su vida.

fr.L: pour qu’y fuie le meurtrier qui aurait tué son prochain sans le savoir, et qui ne le haïssait pas auparavant ; et il fuira dans l’une de ces villes et vivra :
fr.B: afin que quiconque aurait tué son prochain par accident, sans avoir été son ennemi auparavant, puisse s’y réfugier. En fuyant dans l’une de ces villes, cette personne pourrait rester en vie.
fr.R: Si quelqu’un tuait une autre personne par accident, sans l’avoir détestée avant, il pouvait s’enfuir dans l’une de ces villes et rester en vie.

sw.L: ili mwuaji akimbilie huko, amwuaye jirani yake bila kujua, wala hakuwa akimchukia tangu zamani; naye akimbilie mji mmojawapo wa miji hii na kuishi:
sw.B: ili mtu yeyote aliyemwua jirani yake kwa bahati mbaya, bila kuwa adui yake hapo kabla, apate kukimbilia huko. Kwa kukimbilia mmojawapo wa miji hii, mtu huyo angeweza kubaki hai.
sw.R: Mtu akimwua mwenzake kwa bahati mbaya, bila kuwa amemchukia hapo kabla, angeweza kukimbilia mmojawapo wa miji hii na kubaki hai.

decisions.choice: without knowledge: without meaning to, by accident
decisions.reason: The killing was not intended. The law of 19:4-6 uses the same words and gives the example of an axe head that flies off and kills a companion.

decisions.choice: from yesterday and the third day: before, in time past
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "yesterday and the day before" for any time before. The killer had no past hatred for the one who died, which shows it was not murder (19:4, 6, 11).

decisions.choice: a killer, he: anyone who kills, man or woman
decisions.reason: The law is written with masculine words, as Hebrew laws usually are, but it covers anyone who killed by accident (Numbers 35:15).

decisions.choice: live: be safe from the avenger of blood
decisions.reason: The city protected the killer from the dead person's relative who would avenge the death (19:6; Numbers 35:12, 19).

decisions.choice: anyone who had killed a neighbor / someone
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use words that are already inclusive; Literal keeps the masculine words of the Hebrew.

source.text: אֶת־בֶּ֧צֶר בַּמִּדְבָּ֛ר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ הַמִּישֹׁ֖ר לָרֻֽאוּבֵנִ֑יוְאֶת־רָאמֹ֤ת בַּגִּלְעָד֙ לַגָּדִ֔י וְאֶת־גּוֹלָ֥ן בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן לַֽמְנַשִּֽׁי׃

records.literal_gloss: Bezer in the wilderness in [the] land of the plateau for the Reubenites, and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites, and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.

en.L: Bezer in the wilderness, in the land of the plateau, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.
en.B: They were Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau, for the Reubenites; Ramoth in Gilead, for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.
en.R: The towns were Bezer in the desert on the high plain, for the tribe of Reuben; Ramoth in Gilead, for the tribe of Gad; and Golan in Bashan, for the tribe of Manasseh.

es.L: Béser en el desierto, en la tierra de la meseta, para los rubenitas; y Ramot en Galaad para los gaditas; y Golán en Basán para los manasitas.
es.B: Eran Béser, en el desierto, en la meseta, para los rubenitas; Ramot de Galaad, para los gaditas; y Golán de Basán, para los manasitas.
es.R: Los pueblos eran Béser, en el desierto de la llanura alta, para la tribu de Rubén; Ramot, en Galaad, para la tribu de Gad; y Golán, en Basán, para la tribu de Manasés.

fr.L: Betser dans le désert, dans le pays du plateau, pour les Rubénites ; et Ramoth en Galaad pour les Gadites ; et Golân dans le Bashân pour les Manassites.
fr.B: C’étaient Betser, dans le désert, sur le plateau, pour les Rubénites ; Ramoth en Galaad, pour les Gadites ; et Golân dans le Bashân, pour les Manassites.
fr.R: Ces villes étaient Betser, dans le désert du haut plateau, pour la tribu de Ruben ; Ramoth, en Galaad, pour la tribu de Gad ; et Golân, dans le Bashân, pour la tribu de Manassé.

sw.L: Beseri nyikani, katika nchi ya uwanda wa juu, kwa ajili ya Wareubeni; na Ramothi katika Gileadi kwa ajili ya Wagadi; na Golani katika Bashani kwa ajili ya Wamanase.
sw.B: Miji hiyo ilikuwa Beseri nyikani katika uwanda wa juu, kwa ajili ya Wareubeni; Ramothi katika Gileadi, kwa ajili ya Wagadi; na Golani katika Bashani, kwa ajili ya Wamanase.
sw.R: Miji hiyo ilikuwa Beseri, katika jangwa la nyanda za juu, kwa ajili ya kabila la Reubeni; Ramothi, katika Gileadi, kwa ajili ya kabila la Gadi; na Golani, katika Bashani, kwa ajili ya kabila la Manase.

decisions.choice: the plateau: the high tableland north of the Arnon
decisions.reason: The word means level ground. It names the high plain of Moab east of the Dead Sea (3:10; Joshua 13:9, 16).

decisions.choice: the Manassites: the half-tribe of Manasseh east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Only half of Manasseh settled east of the Jordan, in Gilead and Bashan (3:13).

decisions.choice: Bezer, Ramoth, Golan: one city in each eastern tribe, from south to north
decisions.reason: The three cities run from south to north, so that every part of the land east of the Jordan was within reach of a refuge (Joshua 20:8; 21:36-38).

decisions.choice: They were / The towns were
decisions.reason: The Hebrew list follows the colon of verse 42; Balanced and Readable, which ended verse 42 with a full stop, begin the list with a short clause.

decisions.choice: the tribe of Reuben, Gad, Manasseh
decisions.reason: Readable names the tribes instead of using the forms "Reubenites", "Gadites" and "Manassites".

source.text: וְזֹ֖את הַתּוֹרָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֣ם מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And this [is] the law that set Moses before [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And this [is] the law that Moses set before the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: This is the law that Moses laid before the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.
en.R: These are the teachings Moses gave to the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.

es.L: Y esta [es] la ley que Moisés puso delante de los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Esta es la ley que Moisés presentó a los israelitas.
es.R: Estas son las enseñanzas que Moisés dio a los israelitas.

fr.L: Et ceci [est] la loi que Moïse plaça devant les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: Voici la loi que Moïse exposa aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.
fr.R: Voici les enseignements que Moïse a donnés aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.

sw.L: Na hii [ndiyo] sheria ambayo Musa aliiweka mbele ya wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Hii ndiyo sheria ambayo Musa aliiweka mbele ya Waisraeli.
sw.R: Haya ndiyo mafundisho ambayo Musa aliwapa Waisraeli.

decisions.choice: this: a heading for what follows
decisions.reason: Verses 44-49 introduce Moses' second speech, which begins at 5:1 and holds the main body of the law (chapters 5-26).

decisions.choice: law: Moses' teaching
decisions.reason: As at 1:5, the word means instruction, the whole of what Moses teaches.

decisions.choice: teachings
decisions.reason: Readable says "teachings" for the law, as Deuteronomy's terms call for.
